title: กรมอุตุฯ ประกาศฉบับ 7 "ฝนตกหนักถึงหนักมาก" ระวังน้ำท่วมฉับพลัน น้ำป่า 7-9 ส.ค.นี้

desc: ฮุนได ขนทัพครบไลน์อัพลงสนาม ส่งแคมเปญใหญ่ Hyundai Game On, Deal On ร่วมเชียร์ไทย คว้าชัย ASEAN Hyundai Cup™ 2026 พร้อมอัดโปรแรง ลดสูงสุด 500,000 บาท

title_cn: 母亲节消费110亿铢创7年新高 年轻代因养育成本高陷消费低迷
summary_cn: 泰国商会（Thai Chamber of Commerce）预测今年母亲节消费支出达110亿铢，创七年来新高。报告指出，千禧一代（Gen Y）因子女养育成本过高而放弃生育计划；Z世代（Gen Z）消费意愿尚未明确。经济压力正在深刻影响年轻家庭的生育决策和消费行为。

desc: Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck, chairman of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC), sent a letter to Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul last week seeking justice and aiming to resolve the deadlock at the regulator over his qualifications.

title: Tiger attack sparks safety review
desc: The tragic death of a forest ranger at the jaws of a tiger has prompted grief and difficult questions. Was this an isolated incident, or a warning sign of a growing overlap between humans and Thailand's recovering tiger population? This explainer explores the latest findings, the behaviour of wild tigers and the measures being taken to prevent such a tragedy from happening again.
title_cn: 护林员遭虎咬身亡引发安全审查
summary_cn: 一名护林员被老虎咬死，引发对人类与泰国虎群活动重叠加剧的深层思考。当局启动安全评估，深入研究野生虎习性和人兽冲突成因，制定防范措施以防止类似悲剧再度发生。事件背后反映泰国虎保护成果与安全风险间的矛盾。
desc_original: The tragic death of a forest ranger at the jaws of a tiger has prompted grief and difficult questions. Was this an isolated incident, or a warning sign of a growing overlap between humans and Thailand's recovering tiger population? This explainer explores the latest findings, the behaviour of wild tigers and the measures being taken to prevent such a tragedy from happening again.

title: Senator urges dissolution of NBTC board
desc: Senator Premsak Piayura has urged Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to dissolve the entire National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) board and restart the selection process.
title_cn: 参议员敦促解散国家广播电信委员会董事会
summary_cn: 参议员普雷姆萨克（Premsak Piayura）敦促总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）解散国家广播电信委员会（NBTC）所有董事，并重新启动选拔程序。此举反映对该机构治理结构和决策过程的关切和质疑。
desc_original: Senator Premsak Piayura has urged Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to dissolve the entire National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) board and restart the selection process.

title: Roojai reveals plans to diversify for 2030
desc: Online insurer Roojai has unveiled an ambitious growth strategy for 2030, betting on artificial intelligence (AI), new health insurance products and regional expansion to strengthen its position in Thailand's increasingly competitive insurance market.
title_cn: 线上保险商Roojai发布2030年多元化战略
summary_cn: 线上保险公司Roojai宣布2030年发展规划，将重点投资人工智能技术、开发新型健康保险产品、拓展地区市场份额，以强化其在泰国竞争激烈的保险行业中的地位。
desc_original: Online insurer Roojai has unveiled an ambitious growth strategy for 2030, betting on artificial intelligence (AI), new health insurance products and regional expansion to strengthen its position in Thailand's increasingly competitive insurance market.

title: StanChart sees weak baht for rest of 2026
desc: Standard Chartered Bank (Thai) expects the baht to remain weak for the rest of the year, despite its recent appreciation this week driven by external factors.
title_cn: 渣打银行预期泰铢年末前持续走弱
summary_cn: 渣打银行（泰国）预计泰铢在2026年余下时间内将保持疲软趋势，尽管本周受外部因素推动略有升值。这一预期对有外币资产、海外留学或跨境汇兑需求的人士具有参考意义。
desc_original: Standard Chartered Bank (Thai) expects the baht to remain weak for the rest of the year, despite its recent appreciation this week driven by external factors.

title: CIMBT calls for sustainable data centre investment
desc: CIMB Thai Bank (CIMBT) has urged policymakers to prioritise sustainable investment in data centre projects to maximise the long-term benefits for the Thai economy.
title_cn: 泰国中华银行呼吁优先投资可持续数据中心
summary_cn: 泰国中华银行（CIMB Thai）敦促政策制定者优先考虑对数据中心项目的可持续投资，以最大化对泰国经济的长期效益。
desc_original: CIMB Thai Bank (CIMBT) has urged policymakers to prioritise sustainable investment in data centre projects to maximise the long-term benefits for the Thai economy.

title: Myanmar targets growth in trade
desc: Thailand and Myanmar have pledged to deepen economic cooperation, reopen key trade routes and accelerate investment as both countries seek to raise bilateral trade to US$12 billion (397 billion baht).
title_cn: 缅甸瞄准贸易增长 泰缅携手推高双边贸易
summary_cn: 泰国与缅甸承诺深化经济合作，重启主要贸易路线并加快投资步伐，力争将双边贸易提升至120亿美元（约3970亿泰铢）。
desc_original: Thailand and Myanmar have pledged to deepen economic cooperation, reopen key trade routes and accelerate investment as both countries seek to raise bilateral trade to US$12 billion (397 billion baht).

title: El Niño effect may result in rice exports of 7m tonnes
desc: The El Niño phenomenon is expected to help Thailand achieve its rice export goal of 7 million tonnes this year, according to a shipper.
title_cn: 厄尔尼诺效应或助泰国水稻出口达700万吨
summary_cn: 根据出口商预测，厄尔尼诺（El Niño）现象预计将帮助泰国实现今年700万吨的水稻出口目标。
desc_original: The El Niño phenomenon is expected to help Thailand achieve its rice export goal of 7 million tonnes this year, according to a shipper.

title: MoUs boost Myanmar ties

title: 泰国数据中心投资聚焦资源保障 拟实施差别化水电价政策
desc: 泰国头条新闻社 据泰媒报道，8月6日，泰国内阁近日批准了《总理府办公室关于数据中心业务政策委员会的条例》草案。泰国投资促进委员会（BOI）表示，将据此重新审查数据中心项目投资优惠政策框架，回应社会对能源、水资源和环境影响的关切。 BOI数据显示，2024年至2026年期间，已批准42个数据中心投资项目，总投资额约7500亿泰铢。 在内阁8月5日批准《总理府办公室关于数据中心业务政策委员会的条例》草案后，泰国将成立国家级数据中心政策委员会，由副总理担任主席，负责统筹数字基础设施发展。 BOI秘书长纳立表示，BOI将全面重新评估数据中心项目的投资促进政策，提高项目审查标准，使其符合新成立的数据中心政策委员会的指导方针，确保项目能够为国家创造更大价值，同时减少对能源、水资源、环境及社区的影响。 他表示，泰国面临的课题不是在全面拒绝数据中心投资和毫无限制接受所有项目之间二选一，而是要思考泰国真正需要什么样的数据中心，并共同制定规则，使国家和人民获得最大利益。 为回应社会各界关切，BOI董事会在副总理艾卡尼的领导下，提出从四个方面加强数据中心项目审查，并据此决定是否给予投资优惠。包括要求企业创造高技能就业岗位、开展技术转移，并与高校合作培养本土工程师。例如，AWS与泰王科技学院合作开设数据中心工程专业课程，谷歌则实施“Samart Skills”人才培养计划。 同时，鼓励企业优先采购本土供应链产品，推动泰国本地供应商和中小企业进入数据中心产业链。 此外，还要求数据中心向泰国初创企业、高校及中小企业开放算力资源，并提供价格合理的云计算服务，推动本国人工智能生态发展。 BOI支持国家能源政策委员会提出的措施，将数据中心单独列为特殊用电类别，执行高于其他行业的电价，以反映电网扩容成本。同时，要求投资者提交用电履约保证金（Bank Guarantee），筛选具备真实投资能力的企业，并强制执行绿色数据中心标准及电能使用效率（PUE）指标。 BOI建议对数据中心实施较高的工业用水价格，并要求企业完善冷却系统、水资源循环利用及节水措施，确保旱季期间不会影响农业生产和社区居民用水。 政府将制定数据中心选址分区制度，并加快编制全国电力资源地图和水资源地图，预防火灾、噪声污染、热污染及污水排放等问题。 BOI表示，目前泰国正逐步成为全球数据中心关键设备的重要制造基地。目前，希捷（Seagate）和西部数据（Western Digital）在泰国生产硬盘驱动器；英业达（Inventec）和QMB生产人工智能服务器；InnoLight、Celestica和Fabrinet生产高速光通信设备；达尔塔电子（Delta）则生产数据中心冷却系统。下一阶段，BOI将推动这些设备在泰国本地实现采购和配套，减少“出口组装后再进口”的模式，进一步提高本地产业附加值和经济乘数效应。 针对社会关注的数据中心投资
title_cn: 泰国强化数据中心投资管理，差别化电价政策护资源
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准数据中心政策新规，将成立国家级数据中心委员会加强统筹。当局计划对数据中心实施差别化的高电价和水价，同时要求企业创造高技能就业、采购本地供应链、向本土企业开放算力资源。政府还将推行选址分区制度，建立电力和水资源地图，预防环境污染，推动本地硬件制造基地建设。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社 据泰媒报道，8月6日，泰国内阁近日批准了《总理府办公室关于数据中心业务政策委员会的条例》草案。泰国投资促进委员会（BOI）表示，将据此重新审查数据中心项目投资优惠政策框架，回应社会对能源、水资源和环境影响的关切。 BOI数据显示，2024年至2026年期间，已批准42个数据中心投资项目，总投资额约7500亿泰铢。 在内阁8月5日批准《总理府办公室关于数据中心业务政策委员会的条例》草案后，泰国将成立国家级数据中心政策委员会，由副总理担任主席，负责统筹数字基础设施发展。 BOI秘书长纳立表示，BOI将全面重新评估数据中心项目的投资促进政策，提高项目审查标准，使其符合新成立的数据中心政策委员会的指导方针，确保项目能够为国家创造更大价值，同时减少对能源、水资源、环境及社区的影响。 他表示，泰国面临的课题不是在全面拒绝数据中心投资和毫无限制接受所有项目之间二选一，而是要思考泰国真正需要什么样的数据中心，并共同制定规则，使国家和人民获得最大利益。 为回应社会各界关切，BOI董事会在副总理艾卡尼的领导下，提出从四个方面加强数据中心项目审查，并据此决定是否给予投资优惠。包括要求企业创造高技能就业岗位、开展技术转移，并与高校合作培养本土工程师。例如，AWS与泰王科技学院合作开设数据中心工程专业课程，谷歌则实施“Samart Skills”人才培养计划。 同时，鼓励企业优先采购本土供应链产品，推动泰国本地供应商和中小企业进入数据中心产业链。 此外，还要求数据中心向泰国初创企业、高校及中小企业开放算力资源，并提供价格合理的云计算服务，推动本国人工智能生态发展。 BOI支持国家能源政策委员会提出的措施，将数据中心单独列为特殊用电类别，执行高于其他行业的电价，以反映电网扩容成本。同时，要求投资者提交用电履约保证金（Bank Guarantee），筛选具备真实投资能力的企业，并强制执行绿色数据中心标准及电能使用效率（PUE）指标。 BOI建议对数据中心实施较高的工业用水价格，并要求企业完善冷却系统、水资源循环利用及节水措施，确保旱季期间不会影响农业生产和社区居民用水。 政府将制定数据中心选址分区制度，并加快编制全国电力资源地图和水资源地图，预防火灾、噪声污染、热污染及污水排放等问题。 BOI表示，目前泰国正逐步成为全球数据中心关键设备的重要制造基地。目前，希捷（Seagate）和西部数据（Western Digital）在泰国生产硬盘驱动器；英业达（Inventec）和QMB生产人工智能服务器；InnoLight、Celestica和Fabrinet生产高速光通信设备；达尔塔电子（Delta）则生产数据中心冷却系统。下一阶段，BOI将推动这些设备在泰国本地实现采购和配套，减少“出口组装后再进口”的模式，进一步提高本地产业附加值和经济乘数效应。 针对社会关注的数据中心投资

title: 泰国机场10月接轨国际 托运行李发现可疑物品可不开箱通知直接检查
desc: 泰国头条新闻社 据泰媒报道，8月6日，泰国民航局就《2026年托运行李航空运输安全检查公告》作出说明。该公告将于10月16日正式生效。 泰国民航局表示，新措施旨在进一步提升航空安全水平，使泰国航空安保制度与国际标准及全球多个国家和地区的通行做法接轨。同时强调，托运行李只有在存在合理怀疑的情况下才会被开箱检查，并非对所有旅客行李进行检查。 此前，泰国民航局已修订航空安全相关法规，以适应航空旅客数量持续增长，并提升安检效率。相关公告已于2026年2月发布，其中有关托运行李检查的新规定将于2026年10月16日正式实施，以便机场、航空公司及相关单位提前做好人员培训、系统建设及旅客宣传等准备工作。 民航局进一步解释，未经事先通知旅客开箱检查托运行李，仅适用于X光安检设备发现可疑物品或可能危及航空安全的物品时，并非针对普通旅客。 所有开箱检查均须在指定区域进行，全程实行影像记录并保存证据，确保事后可追溯，包括记录检查人员身份、检查发现的物品等信息。完成检查后，相关部门还须按照规定通知旅客，其托运行李已被开箱检查。 民航局指出，这一做法已是国际通行的航空安保标准，目前新加坡、日本、韩国以及中东、欧洲多个国家和美国均已实施类似措施，目的是防止危险物品被带上飞机，同时提高航班运行效率，减少因等待旅客到场开箱而导致的航班延误。 为方便旅客，民航局建议使用符合国际标准的行李锁，如TSA海关锁。如确有必要，安检人员可使用专用工具开启此类锁具，而不会损坏行李箱。 此外，旅客出行前应提前了解禁止携带物品及可能需要重点检查的物品清单。由于类似措施已在全球众多机场实施，旅客的行李在始发地、中转地或目的地均可能接受进一步检查。如携带违反当地法律法规的物品，可能影响正常出行。 如旅客因上述措施遇到问题或行李受到损坏，可向所乘航空公司提出投诉，也可通过泰国民航局投诉系统提交申诉，民航局将依法核查事实并按程序处理。 （编译：hansa ；审核：wan；来源：matichon） The post 泰国机场10月接轨国际 托运行李发现可疑物品可不开箱通知直接检查 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国机场10月接轨国际 托运行李发现可疑物品可不开箱通知直接检查
summary_cn: 泰国民航局将于10月16日实施新规，对于X光安检发现的可疑物品，可在未事先通知旅客的情况下直接开箱检查托运行李。检查须在指定区域进行且全程录像，检查后须通知旅客。这一措施与国际标准接轨，新加坡、日本、韩国等多国均已采用。建议旅客使用符合国际标准的行李锁（如TSA海关锁），并提前了解禁止携带物品清单。

title: Foreigner’s spirit house snack stop amuses, divides Thai netizens
desc: Foreigner’s spirit house snack stop amuses, divides Thai netizens Legacy A foreign man was caught on CCTV footage taking food and drink offerings from a spirit house outside a home in Phuket , prompting mixed reactions online. The Phuket spirit house theft was shared by Facebook user Bank Marlboro, who posted CCTV footage last night, August 5. He said the incident took place outside a friend’s home in the Kata area of Karon subdistrict. The video shows the foreign man walking along the street before changing direction towards the spirit house. After appearing to check that no one was watching, he approached the shrine and removed several offerings. The man was seen taking a small plastic tray containing food and what appeared to be a bottled drink. He then walked to a second spirit house nearby but left after finding no offerings there. Photo via Facebook/ Bank Marlboro In the footage, the foreigner was wearing a purple-and-orange long-sleeved shirt with the sleeves rolled up, dark blue shorts, glasses and trainers while carrying two plastic bags. title_cn: 外国人取走灵魂屋供品逗乐泰网民
summary_cn: 普吉岛卡隆区一名外国人被监控录像拍到从住宅外的灵魂屋（泰国传统佛教建筑）取走食物和饮料供品，引发泰国网民热议。视频显示该男子穿着紫橙长袖衬衫、深蓝短裤和眼镜，携两个塑料袋。有网民认为这是盗窃行为，也有人对其行为感到好笑。此事反映出外国游客与本地文化差异和对传统信仰尊重的问题。

title: Thailand explores Moscow Metro’s formula for reliable rail services
desc: Thailand explores Moscow Metro’s formula for reliable rail services Legacy Thailand’s Ministry of Transport visited Moscow Metro yesterday, August 5, to study rail operations, digital passenger services and maintenance practices that could be adapted for the country’s railway network . Deputy Prime Minister and Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn led the Thai delegation during the visit, which followed the signing of a transport cooperation MOU between Thailand and Russia. Phiphat and senior transport officials also toured Maryina Roshcha station and the Aminevskoye Electric Depot to study Moscow Metro’s operational systems and exchange technical expertise. Photo via Ministry of Transport Phiphat said the discussions focused on how Moscow Metro handles large numbers of passengers while keeping services safe, reliable and cost-effective. The talks covered digital passenger services, ticketing systems, train operations and maintenance. Moscow Metro demonstrated several cashless payment options , including bank cards, QR codes, digital devices, biometric verification and Face Pay. According to the operator, around 93% of passengers use cashless payment
title_cn: 泰国取经莫斯科地铁 探索可靠铁路运营之道
summary_cn: 泰国副总理兼交通部长披帕访问莫斯科地铁，与俄方就铁路运营、乘客服务和维护实践进行交流。双方讨论如何在保证安全可靠的前提下处理大客流，莫斯科地铁展示了多种无现金支付方式（银行卡、二维码、生物识别、面部识别等），约93%乘客使用无现金支付。此访紧跟泰俄交通合作备忘录的签署，旨在为泰国铁路系统升级寻求经验借鉴。

title: Bangkok starts work on second street food hub near Pathumwananurak Park
desc: Bangkok starts work on second street food hub near Pathumwananurak Park Legacy Construction began on the second hawker centre in Bangkok near Pathumwananurak Park in Pathumwan district, following the launch of the city’s first dedicated street food hub at Lumphini Park . The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA), led by Governor Chadchart Sittipunt, opened the first hawker centre at Lumphini Park in April as part of its policy to reorganise public footpaths, improve pedestrian access and provide affordable operating spaces for street food vendors. The Lumphini Park hawker centre is located near Gate 5 of the park, close to Exit 6 of Sala Daeng BTS Station and Exit 1 of Lumphini MRT Station. It operates daily from 5am to midnight and has become particularly popular during the early morning. The BMA relocated well-known street food vendors previously operating around Lumphini Park to the new site, where traders pay a rental fee of 60 baht per day. The facility provides about 130 stalls. Photo via Facebook/ กรุงเทพมหานคร The centre is equipped with water supply systems, drainage, grease traps, dishwashing areas and communal seating to support both vendors and customers. City
title_cn: 曼谷在帕通万区开工建设第二座美食广场
summary_cn: 曼谷市政府在帕通万区帕通瓦鲁纳克公园附近启动第二座美食广场建设。第一座位于隆披尼公园，于4月开放，拥约130个摊位，日租金60泰铢，营业时间早5点至午夜，已成为清晨热门去处。新美食广场配备供水、排水、油脂收集、洗碗区和公共座位等设施，旨在整顿人行道、改善行人通行、为街头小贩提供廉价经营场所。

title: 百年华社共忆侨批情！泰华进出口商会举办《给阿嬷的情书》专场观影
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月2日下午，泰华进出口商会在曼谷 Central World 9楼 SF World Cinema第8号影厅发起专场观影活动，诚邀理事同仁偕家属共同观赏潮汕话华语剧情片《给阿嬷的情书》。作为一部以泰国华人社会为背景、以“侨批”为情感载体的现象级电影，该片于8月6日在泰国正式公映。当天该会成员及家属等近五百人齐聚一堂，共同感受这场跨越山海、守望半个多世纪的南洋往事。 中国驻泰大使馆公使衔参赞吴志武、泰国前副总理陈汉誉警上将、泰国前皇家警察总署长阿伦警上将亦莅临出席，与商会同仁共同观影，体现了中泰各界对华人文化传承的高度关注与支持。出席观影的商会成员包括理事长林俊然，永远荣誉理事长陈汉士、刘秉青、郑岳龙、林齐锐，永远名誉理事长王志民、吕木龙、陈运楼、徐光辉、陈锡源、陈绍扬，名誉理事长陈扬钦、李炎炎、徐位合以及诸位副理事长、理事同仁和青年部成员等。现场气氛温馨热烈，体现了泰华进出口商会作为百年华社的凝聚力。 《给阿嬷的情书》与泰国渊源深厚，影片聚焦海外华人远赴暹罗打拼的历史，传递的孝道、诚信与家庭纽带等文化价值，引发了泰籍华人的强烈共鸣。泰国是华侨华人安居乐业、拼搏发展的热土，数百年来，一代代华侨华人与泰国人民携手共建家园。影片中潮汕先辈赴泰打拼的历程，更是让海外潮商感同身受——泰国众多华人商会历经百年传承，先辈们皆是背井离乡，凭借勤劳肯干的品质在当地扎根立足。该片以“侨批”（昔日南洋华人寄回故乡、兼具汇款与家书功能的特殊信件）为核心线索，90%以上的细节与情节均有真实原型，生动还原了那段厚重的历史。观影结束后，现场反响热烈，与会者纷纷分享观影感悟，被影片传递的情感与精神深深打动。 理事长林俊然表示，影片所展现的“有情有义”精神，既是潮汕文化中团结互助、勤奋打拼的生动写照，也与泰华进出口商会百年来秉持的诚信立业、情系桑梓的传统一脉相承。侨批所承载的情义与坚守，正是影片最触动人心的精神内核。 永远荣誉理事长陈汉士感慨道，电影让他回忆起先辈们当年在泰国白手起家的艰辛岁月。每一封侨批背后，都是一段海外游子对家乡亲人的深深思念与责任担当，影片对历史的真实再现令人动容。 青年部主任陈丽璇在观影后真情流露，她提到自己的父亲早年在泰国经营侨批馆，从小看着父亲处理一封封来自家乡的信件和汇款，那些泛黄的纸笺在她心中就是家的温度。直到坐在银幕前，她才真正走进父亲当年的工作世界——每一封侨批背后，都是无数海外游子对故乡亲人沉甸甸的思念与责任，是穿越战火与风浪也要将钱款平安送达的承诺。她呼吁青年部成员，不要让侨批的故事只留在博物馆里，要主动去了解、去讲述、去传承，因为这不仅是家族的记忆，更是整个泰华社会共同的根与魂。 诸位副理事长及理事同仁也一致认为，影片让大家更深刻领悟到侨批文化所蕴含的信义担当与家国情怀。对于华裔青年一代而言，这不仅是一部电影，更是一堂生动的文化教

title: Police seize 93 million baht in Roi Et drug money laundering raid
desc: Police seize 93 million baht in Roi Et drug money laundering raid Legacy Police seized assets worth more than 93.3 million baht during a raid on a livestock farm in Roi Et that was used to launder money for a drug trafficking network . Officers from the Narcotics Suppression Bureau searched NP Farm Mueang At 888 in Ban Namkham, At Samat district, at around 10am yesterday, August 5, as part of an ongoing investigation into a regional drug distribution network. The investigation began after the arrests of two suspects, Janthasak and Kanlaya, who were caught with 62,000 methamphetamine pills, locally known as Yaba, on November 17 last year. Police said further inquiries found the pair had been distributing drugs under the instructions of another suspect, Thanawat. Officers later arrested Thanawat and two additional suspects on May 15, seizing 325 Yaba tablets. title: Thailand bets big on AI despite talent shortage
desc: Thailand is emerging as Asia's most ambitious artificial intelligence (AI) market, with local enterprises planning the region's largest increase in AI investment despite an acute shortage of skilled talent, according to a survey by Alibaba Cloud.
title_cn: 泰国大力投资人工智能 尽管面临人才短缺
summary_cn: 根据阿里巴巴云（Alibaba Cloud）的最新调查，泰国正成为亚洲人工智能投资最为积极的市场。尽管面临严重的高端技术人才短缺困境，泰国本地企业仍计划实现亚洲地区最大幅度的AI投资增长。这反映了泰国在科技产业转型中的雄心壮志，但同时也暴露了教育和人才培养方面的挑战。

title: Life insurance poised for steady growth in H2
desc: The life insurance industry is expected to maintain growth in the second half of 2026, driven by rising demand for health protection, retirement planning and investment-linked products, despite persistent economic uncertainty and weaker household purchasing power, according to the Thai Life Assurance Association (TLAA).
title_cn: 寿险行业预期下半年持续增长
summary_cn: 泰国人寿保险协会（Thai Life Assurance Association）预测2026年下半年寿险行业将维持增长态势。尽管面临经济不确定性和家庭购买力下降的压力，但民众对健康保险、养老规划和投资型保险产品的需求持续上升，将成为推动行业增长的关键动力。

desc: Cambodian man allegedly stabbed to death by fellow countryman Legacy A Cambodian man was killed after being stabbed at a market in Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani, today, August 6. Police later arrested a fellow Cambodian national during a standoff in a nearby street. Officers were called to the market in Khlong Nueng subdistrict, where they found 37 year old Eu with stab wounds to his neck and right abdomen. Rescue workers provided first aid before rushing him to hospital, where he later died. Photo via Naewna Police reviewed CCTV footage and identified the attacker as the victim’s Cambodian co-worker . Investigators tracked him to Soi Thep Kunchon 15, where he had fled after the attack. title: Chiang Rai gold robbery suspects flee to Laos with 13 million baht haul
desc: Chiang Rai gold robbery suspects flee to Laos with 13 million baht haul Legacy Two suspects fled to Laos with gold jewellery worth about 13 million baht after robbing a shop in Chiang Rai on Tuesday, August 4. Police identified one of the suspects as a Lao national. The robbery took place on Tuesday evening at a gold shop inside a shopping mall in Chiang Khong district, Chiang Rai. One suspect, dressed in a brown jacket and beige trousers, threatened staff and customers with a firearm while his accomplice, wearing a red hooded sweatshirt and long jeans, jumped over the counter and filled a bag with gold necklaces and bracelets. The pair escaped with jewellery valued at about 13 million baht before fleeing the scene on a motorcycle, investigators said. Photo via Facebook/ ศรัณยู ภัตติจารี Security camera footage later showed the suspects abandoning the motorcycle in a wooded area near the giant golden catfish sculpture on the Mekong River in Chiang Rai. Police believe they then crossed into Laos by ferry. Investigators found the motorcycle had been rented from a vehicle hire business near Bak Ferry Pier, a crossing point used by travellers heading to Huay Xai in Bokeo province, Laos

title: Hlun Solo autopsy points to heart failure, toxins not ruled out
desc: Hlun Solo autopsy points to heart failure, toxins not ruled out Legacy Thailand’s Department of Justice has found no evidence of physical assault in the preliminary autopsy of Thai YouTuber Bowornthat “Hlun Solo” Pengsuk , whose body was returned from Georgia today, August 6. Hlun’s body was found at a hotel in Tbilisi, Georgia, on July 14 after he was reported missing earlier that month . Assistant Professor Dr Worawit Waiyawut, deputy director of the Central Institute of Forensic Science, said the examination found no bruises, fractures or other signs of physical injury. No abnormalities were found in the organs, except for the heart, which will undergo further laboratory testing, including tissue and genetic analysis. Preliminary findings indicate the death was caused by cardiac and circulatory system failure, but investigators have not ruled out the possibility of toxins or chemical substances. The Ministry of Justice will request additional forensic information from authorities in Georgia , including toxicology results. summary_cn: 泰国YouTuber博沃恩塔·Hlun Solo彭速克7月14日在格鲁吉亚第比利斯酒店内身亡。司法部法医科学中心初步验尸未发现外伤迹象，器官无异常，仅心脏需进一步检验。初步结论指向心脏循环系统衰竭，但未排除毒物或化学物质可能。格鲁吉亚尚未出具正式死因证明，泰国司法部将向格鲁吉亚当局索取毒理检验等补充法医信息。
desc_original: Hlun Solo autopsy points to heart failure, toxins not ruled out Legacy Thailand’s Department of Justice has found no evidence of physical assault in the preliminary autopsy of Thai YouTuber Bowornthat “Hlun Solo” Pengsuk , whose body was returned from Georgia today, August 6. Hlun’s body was found at a hotel in Tbilisi, Georgia, on July 14 after he was reported missing earlier that month . Assistant Professor Dr Worawit Waiyawut, deputy director of the Central Institute of Forensic Science, said the examination found no bruises, fractures or other signs of physical injury. No abnormalities were found in the organs, except for the heart, which will undergo further laboratory testing, including tissue and genetic analysis. Preliminary findings indicate the death was caused by cardiac and circulatory system failure, but investigators have not ruled out the possibility of toxins or chemical substances. The Ministry of Justice will request additional forensic information from authorities in Georgia , including toxicology results. Georgia has not yet recorded an official cause of death on the death certificate. Photo via Royal Thai Embassy in Ankara Hlun’s b

title: Customs seize trading cards, matcha over false import declarations
desc: Customs seize trading cards, matcha over false import declarations Legacy Thailand’s Customs Department has seized a shipment of imported trading card game products and matcha powder from Japan after discovering false customs declarations and missing import permits. The seizure was announced yesterday, August 5, after officers at Suvarnabhumi Airport Cargo Customs Office inspected the shipment and found irregularities in the import declaration. Customs said the shipment lacked the required import permits and was accompanied by false customs declarations, resulting in more than 3.2 million baht in unpaid duties. The department said the import could constitute offences under the Customs Act 2017, Food Act 1979, Export and Import of Goods Act 1979 and Plant Quarantine Act 1964. Photo via Customs Department Officials alleged the shipment was imported without the required permits and that false information had been provided to reduce import duties. The seizure also drew attention from a Japanese matcha specialty store, which commented on the Customs Department’s Facebook post, warning consumers about counterfeit products. “Thank you for sharing this information. Althou

title: 泰国外长呼吁中方出面释疑，切勿激化机场风波矛盾
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，8月5日，针对近日素万那普国际机场中国游客登机受阻事件引发争议，泰国副总理兼外交部长西哈萨接受采访时表示，希望中国驻泰国大使馆加强沟通、增进理解，避免相关表态进一步激化矛盾，影响两国民众感情。 西哈萨表示，此次事件主要涉及交通运输部门职责，应由交通部负责调查处理。但从外交角度来看，泰国希望每一位来泰游客都能拥有良好的旅行体验，无论是在泰停留期间还是离境时。同时，移民管理必须依法进行，在尽可能提供便利的情况下确保程序顺畅。 对于是否应加强对中国游客及相关工作人员关于泰国法律法规的宣传，西哈萨表示，这也是中国驻泰国大使的重要职责，因为类似事件已发生多次，对泰国民众情绪造成一定影响。 西哈萨透露，自己曾与中国驻泰国大使沟通过相关问题，并指出此类事件较为敏感，大使馆应积极出面说明情况、促进双方理解，而不仅仅只是维护中方利益。作为驻泰大使，其职责还包括促进泰中关系发展，增进两国人民之间的相互理解。 西哈萨强调，大使在公开表态时应充分考虑自身职责，不应进一步加剧矛盾。他表示，相信中国驻泰国大使能够理解这一点，正如泰国驻华大使同样肩负维护两国友好关系的重要责任。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：thestandard） The post 泰国外长呼吁中方出面释疑，切勿激化机场风波矛盾 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Marketers urged to find 'invisible' consumers
desc: Nearly 40% of Thai consumers are dubbed "invisible", meaning they rarely engage in the digital world, according to a new survey by Media Intelligence (MI) Group.
title_cn: 调查显示泰国四成消费者「隐形」 数字参与度低
summary_cn: 根据媒体情报集团（Media Intelligence Group）最新调查，泰国约40%的消费者属于「隐形消费者」，这类人群很少在数字平台上进行互动。他们的消费行为主要发生在线下和传统渠道，对数字营销策略构成新的挑战。营销人员需要开发新策略来接触和吸引这一庞大但「隐形」的消费群体。
desc_original: Nearly 40% of Thai consumers are dubbed "invisible", meaning they rarely engage in the digital world, according to a new survey by Media Intelligence (MI) Group.

title: Master plan for the South up to board
desc: The cabinet has approved letting a southern development board draft a regional master plan, shifting the focus from the proposed Land Bridge megaproject to transport connectivity, economic development and public participation.
title_cn: 南部总体发展规划转向运输与经济发展
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准由南部开发委员会起草地区总体发展规划。这一决定标志着泰国南部发展战略的重大调整，政府从争议不断的陆地桥巨型项目转向更务实的运输连接、经济发展和公众参与。新规划将重点关注泰南交通基础设施完善和区域经济一体化。
desc_original: The cabinet has approved letting a southern development board draft a regional master plan, shifting the focus from the proposed Land Bridge megaproject to transport connectivity, economic development and public participation.

title: 60bn gold card budget reviewed
desc: A review of 60 billion baht from the 2025 universal healthcare budget is under way, says Public Health Minister Pattana Promphat, after he questioned whether the money had been properly allocated.
title_cn: 600亿泰铢医疗保险预算启动审查
summary_cn: 泰国公共卫生部长对2025年全民医疗保健预算中的600亿泰铢资金使用情况提出质疑，已启动全面审查。这笔资金涉及泰国全民医保金卡制度的关键部分，审查结果将直接影响医疗服务覆盖范围和效率。
desc_original: A review of 60 billion baht from the 2025 universal healthcare budget is under way, says Public Health Minister Pattana Promphat, after he questioned whether the money had been properly allocated.

title: Navy rejects claims over bunker safety
desc: The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) has rejected claims that border bunkers in Chanthaburi and Trat are unsafe or poorly built, saying photographs circulated online showed unfinished construction and did not reflect the overall condition of the facilities.
title_cn: 海军回应边境防御工事安全质疑
summary_cn: 泰国皇家海军否认关于尖竹汶府和达叻府边境防御工事存在安全隐患或施工缺陷的指控。海军强调网络流传的照片仅显示施工进程中的未完成部分，不足以反映工事的整体质量和安全状况。这回应了近期网络上有关泰国边境防御能力的争议。
desc_original: The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) has rejected claims that border bunkers in Chanthaburi and Trat are unsafe or poorly built, saying photographs circulated online showed unfinished construction and did not reflect the overall condition of the facilities.

title: Why missing links are the smarter choice
desc: Academics support the development of "missing links" in the country's transport network, as these projects can deliver quick results and clearly address economic needs.
title_cn: 完善「缺失环节」项目成为基建优先选择
summary_cn: 学术界支持泰国优先开发运输网络中的「缺失环节」项目，认为相比陆地桥等大型基建项目，这类项目能更快产生经济效益、更清晰地应对现实需求。「缺失环节」项目通常涉及补齐现有网络中的薄弱环节和连接，投资效率更高。
desc_original: Academics support the development of "missing links" in the country's transport network, as these projects can deliver quick results and clearly address economic needs.

title: Rising yen set to boost Japanese tourism
desc: A stronger yen as a result of US-Japan currency interventions could incentivise more Japanese to travel overseas, especially to short-haul destinations such as Thailand, while Thai travellers should not be discouraged from visiting Japan, according to tourism operators.
title_cn: 日元升值有望吸引日本游客赴泰旅游
summary_cn: 由美日货币政策干预引起的日元升值，可能激励更多日本居民出国旅游，特别是选择泰国等近程亚洲目的地。泰国旅游业者认为这将增加日本游客入泰人数，促进区域旅游合作。同时升值的日元也不会劝阻泰国游客赴日旅游。
desc_original: A stronger yen as a result of US-Japan currency interventions could incentivise more Japanese to travel overseas, especially to short-haul destinations such as Thailand, while Thai travellers should not be discouraged from visiting Japan, according to tourism operators.

title: Office says prepared food prices expected to increase
desc: Prices of prepared food are expected to increase as certain ingredients and vegetable prices rise, according to the Trade Policy and Strategy Office (TPSO).
title_cn: 食材菜价上涨 泰国熟食价格预计跟涨
summary_cn: 泰国贸易政策战略办公室（TPSO）警示，由于食材和蔬菜价格上升，熟食价格预计也将随之上涨。这一趋势将直接影响泰国民众的日常消费成本。
desc_original: Prices of prepared food are expected to increase as certain ingredients and vegetable prices rise, according to the Trade Policy and Strategy Office (TPSO).

title: NBTC deadlock imperils several projects
desc: Turmoil at the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) is continuing as its board meeting on Wednesday was aborted, just like last month, after four commissioners boycotted the session over the chairman's qualification status.
title_cn: 泰国通信管理机构陷入僵局 多个项目面临威胁
summary_cn: 泰国广播电信委员会（NBTC）再次陷入僵局。本周三的董事会因四名委员就主席资格问题抵制而被迫中止，这已是连续第二个月发生。委员会内部风波正威胁到多项重要项目的正常推进。
desc_original: Turmoil at the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) is continuing as its board meeting on Wednesday was aborted, just like last month, after four commissioners boycotted the session over the chairman's qualification status.

title: Call for end to diesel export ban as refineries struggle
desc: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) has called on the government to relax its ban on diesel exports, arguing that months of stringent curbs on refined oil shipments, imposed to cushion the fallout from war in the Middle East, are weighing heavily on the sector.
title_cn: 炼油厂陷困境 泰国工业界呼吁解除柴油出口禁令
summary_cn: 泰国工业联盟（FTI）呼吁政府放宽柴油出口禁令。政府为应对中东冲突影响而实施数月的柴油出口管制，已对本土炼油行业造成严重压力。业界主张应该放松这些限制性措施以缓解困境。
desc_original: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) has called on the government to relax its ban on diesel exports, arguing that months of stringent curbs on refined oil shipments, imposed to cushion the fallout from war in the Middle East, are weighing heavily on the sector.

title: Ukraine looks ahead to post-war rebuild riches
desc: Ukraine is encouraging Thai businesses to invest in the country as bilateral relations continue to expand despite the conflict, the Ukrainian embassy said.
title_cn: 乌克兰邀泰企投资战后重建
summary_cn: 乌克兰驻泰大使馆表示，乌克兰正为战后重建做准备，邀请泰国企业投资参与重建项目。尽管冲突仍在继续，两国双边关系仍在扩大。这为泰国企业提供了新的商业机遇。
desc_original: Ukraine is encouraging Thai businesses to invest in the country as bilateral relations continue to expand despite the conflict, the Ukrainian embassy said.

title: Funding to secure Eastern Economic Corridor water supply
desc: The cabinet has approved more than 7 billion baht to strengthen water security in the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC).
title_cn: 东部经济走廊获70亿铢水利投资
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准投入超过70亿泰铢，用于加强东部经济走廊（EEC）的供水安全。这一重大基建投资将为该战略经济发展区提供充足稳定的水资源保障，助力区域建设发展。
desc_original: The cabinet has approved more than 7 billion baht to strengthen water security in the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC).

title: Bankers warn deliberate defaulters
desc: The Thai Bankers' Association (TBA) has warned that deliberate loan defaulters could face legal action and may be barred from obtaining credit in the future.
title_cn: 银行家警告恶意欠款人
summary_cn: 泰国银行家协会（TBA）警告，故意拖欠贷款的人可能面临法律诉讼，并被禁止获得未来信贷，以打击恶意违约行为。
desc_original: The Thai Bankers' Association (TBA) has warned that deliberate loan defaulters could face legal action and may be barred from obtaining credit in the future.

title: Women seek help over explicit videos allegedly by policeman
desc: A group of women have sought legal help after accusing a Songkhla police officer of forcing victims to record explicit videos and allegedly selling them online, with the youngest victim aged four.
title_cn: 女性指控松卡府警察强迫拍摄不当视频
summary_cn: 一群女性寻求法律帮助，指控松卡府（Songkhla）一名警察强迫受害人录制不当视频并涉嫌在网上出售，其中最小受害人仅四岁，案情触及儿童保护和执法违纪。
desc_original: A group of women have sought legal help after accusing a Songkhla police officer of forcing victims to record explicit videos and allegedly selling them online, with the youngest victim aged four.

title: Bitkub in SEC sights over hack
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) submitted additional evidence to police over allegations Bitkub Online concealed a 2021 digital asset hack worth 1.7 billion baht.
title_cn: 证监委调查 Bitkub 隐瞒黑客事件
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）向警方提交追加证据，指控数字资产交易平台 Bitkub Online 隐瞒了2021年价值17亿泰铢的黑客事件，涉嫌欺骗用户。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) submitted additional evidence to police over allegations Bitkub Online concealed a 2021 digital asset hack worth 1.7 billion baht.

title: Govt shows unity amid rumours
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Pheu Thai leader Julapun Amornvivat put on a public display of unity on Tuesday, dismissing speculation the ruling coalition could fracture ahead of an expected no-confidence debate later this year.
title_cn: 政府展示团结，驳斥分裂传言
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）与为泰党领导人朱拉蓬（Julapun Amornvivat）周二公开展示团结，驳斥执政联盟可能在今年晚些时候的不信任投票前分裂的猜测。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Pheu Thai leader Julapun Amornvivat put on a public display of unity on Tuesday, dismissing speculation the ruling coalition could fracture ahead of an expected no-confidence debate later this year.

title: Rail ties with Russia advance
desc: Thailand and Russia have pledged to strengthen railway ties after transport officials from both countries met in Moscow on Wednesday to discuss technology cooperation, skills development and research partnerships.
title_cn: 泰国与俄罗斯加强铁路合作
summary_cn: 泰国与俄罗斯承诺加强铁路联系，两国交通官员周三在莫斯科会面，讨论技术合作、人才培养和研究伙伴关系等基建发展项目。
desc_original: Thailand and Russia have pledged to strengthen railway ties after transport officials from both countries met in Moscow on Wednesday to discuss technology cooperation, skills development and research partnerships.

title: Stern test from within
desc: Less than four months after taking office, the government appears to be confronting the greatest threat to its survival -- not from an emboldened opposition, but from mounting pressures within its own ranks.
title_cn: 来自内部的严峻考验
summary_cn: 泰国政府上台还不到四个月，便面临自成立以来最严峻的生存考验。有趣的是，这种威胁非来自野心勃勃的反对派，而是来自政府内部日益增长的压力。这反映了执政联盟内部存在严重的观点分歧和权力竞争，多个部长级官员频繁发表相悖的政策主张，引发外界对政府凝聚力的担忧。
desc_original: Less than four months after taking office, the government appears to be confronting the greatest threat to its survival -- not from an emboldened opposition, but from mounting pressures within its own ranks.

title: Reformists oppose delay to board poll
desc: A social security reform group on Wednesday petitioned the Central Administrative Court to revoke the postponement of the Social Security Board election. It argued that election officials had misinterpreted an earlier court order and delayed the entire process without sufficient legal grounds.
title_cn: 改革派反对推迟社会保障董事会选举
summary_cn: 社会保障改革团体于本周三向泰国中央行政法院提交请愿书，要求撤销此前对社会保障委员会选举的延期决定。请愿者声称选举管理机构误读了法院的早期判决，在缺乏充分法律依据的情况下强行推迟了整个选举程序。这一争议涉及泰国社会保障体系的民主治理问题。
desc_original: A social security reform group on Wednesday petitioned the Central Administrative Court to revoke the postponement of the Social Security Board election. It argued that election officials had misinterpreted an earlier court order and delayed the entire process without sufficient legal grounds.

title: Home improvement spending set to stay subdued in H2
desc: SET-listed Home Product Center, the operator of HomePro, expects trading conditions to remain challenging in the second half of 2026 as rising energy costs, geopolitical tensions and cautious consumer spending continue to weigh on demand for home improvement products.
title_cn: 下半年家装消费预期继续低迷
summary_cn: HomePro连锁家装超市的运营方Home Product Center（SET上市公司）预计2026年下半年的经营环境将持续恶劣。能源价格高企、国际地缘政治紧张局势升温，加上泰国消费者愈加谨慎的购物心态，这些因素将共同继续压低家庭装修产品的需求。上半年的低迷态势预计难以扭转。
desc_original: SET-listed Home Product Center, the operator of HomePro, expects trading conditions to remain challenging in the second half of 2026 as rising energy costs, geopolitical tensions and cautious consumer spending continue to weigh on demand for home improvement products.

title: K-Asset, JPMAM target lifetime wealth
desc: Kasikorn Asset Management (K-Asset) and JP Morgan Asset Management (JPMAM) are expanding their strategic partnership with a focus on lifetime investment solutions as longer life expectancy and market volatility reshape Thai investors' financial planning.
title_cn: 开泰资管与摩根资管联手开拓终身财富规划
summary_cn: 开泰银行旗下资产管理公司K-Asset与全球投资巨头摩根资产管理（JPMAM）正在深化战略合作关系，共同推出针对终身财富规划的投资解决方案。随着泰国人口预期寿命不断延长、金融市场波动性加剧，投资者的财务规划需求也在发生深刻转变，这种长期战略性产品将迎来更大市场机遇。
desc_original: Kasikorn Asset Management (K-Asset) and JP Morgan Asset Management (JPMAM) are expanding their strategic partnership with a focus on lifetime investment solutions as longer life expectancy and market volatility reshape Thai investors' financial planning.

title: โปรดเกล้าฯ ถอดยศ 3 อดีตข้าราชการตำรวจ และ เรียกคืนเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์ทุกชั้นตรา
desc: ราชกิจจานุเบกษา เผยแพร่ ประกาศ โปรดเกล้าฯ พระราชทานพระบรมราชานุญาตให้ถอดยศอดีตข้าราชการตำรวจ จำนวน 3 ราย ออกจากยศตำรวจ และ เรียกคืนเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์ที่ได้รับพระราชทานทุกชั้นตรา
title_cn: 敕令撤销3名前警官职位并收回全部勋章
summary_cn: 泰国皇家公报日前公布敕令，撤销3名前警察系统高级官员的职务，并同时收回他们所获得的所有皇家勋章。这一举措表明泰国政府对警察队伍的纪律整肃力度在加大，反映了近期因监察和廉政审查引发的高层人事调整。此举将对泰国执法部门产生深远影响。
desc_original: ราชกิจจานุเบกษา เผยแพร่ ประกาศ โปรดเกล้าฯ พระราชทานพระบรมราชานุญาตให้ถอดยศอดีตข้าราชการตำรวจ จำนวน 3 ราย ออกจากยศตำรวจ และ เรียกคืนเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์ที่ได้รับพระราชทานทุกชั้นตรา

desc: ราชกิจจานุเบกษา เผยแพร่ ประกาศ โปรดเกล้าฯ พระราชทานเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์อันเป็นที่เชิดชูยิ่ง ช้างเผือก และเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์อันมีเกียรติยศยิ่งมงกุฎไทย แก่ข้าราชบริพารในพระองค์จำนวน 8 ราย
title_cn: 国王陛下敕令颁授皇家勋章表彰8位宫廷官员
summary_cn: 泰国官方公报宣布，国王陛下向8名皇室服务人员颁授皇家勋章。勋章包括「白象勋章」与「泰国皇冠荣耀勋章」两种，以表彰其长期对皇室的忠诚服务和贡献。
desc_original: ราชกิจจานุเบกษา เผยแพร่ ประกาศ โปรดเกล้าฯ พระราชทานเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์อันเป็นที่เชิดชูยิ่ง ช้างเผือก และเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์อันมีเกียรติยศยิ่งมงกุฎไทย แก่ข้าราชบริพารในพระองค์จำนวน 8 ราย

title: สกัดจับรถตู้ขนแรงงานต่างด้าว ซิ่งเสียหลักพุ่งขึ้นเกาะกลางถนน พบอัดคนมา 43 ชีวิต
desc: เจ้าหน้าที่สนธิกำลัง สกัดจับ "รถตู้ขนแรงงานต่างด้าว" ที่ จ.กาญจนบุรี ซิ่งหนีตำรวจจนเสียหลัก ปีนขึ้นเกาะกลางถนน รวบตัวคนขับชาวไทย และแรงงานเมียนมา พบอัดแน่นกันมา 43 ชีวิต
title_cn: 缉获走私外籍劳工货车 失控冲上路心岛 44人被查获
summary_cn: 泰国执法部队在甘烹碧府(Kanchanaburi)查缉一辆非法运载缅甸籍劳工的货车。该车试图逃避警方追捕时失控，冲上路中岛屿。警方逮捕了泰籍驾驶员并查获44名缅甸籍劳工。事件反映了人工走私问题的严重性。

title: โรงงานถลุงแร่ระเบิด ที่ห้วยกระเจา คนงานเจ็บ 7 ราย ดับแล้ว 2 ศพ
desc: คืบหน้าโรงงานถลุงแร่ระเบิด ที่ห้วยกระเจา จ.กาญจนบุรี คนงานบาดเจ็บ 7 ราย ล่าสุด เสียชีวิตเพิ่ม 2 ศพ บาดเจ็บ 5 ราย
title_cn: 甘烹碧采矿厂爆炸事故致2死5伤
summary_cn: 泰国甘烹碧府淮开咋(Huai Krachao)地区的采矿冶炼工厂发生重大爆炸事故。事故已造成2名工人死亡、5人受伤。这是重大工业安全事件，事故原因正在调查中。

title: “ทนายอานนท์” โพสต์เล่าชะตากรรมนักโทษ ม.112 ในระบอบสีน้ำเงิน
desc: “ทนายอานนท์” ร่อนจดหมายร่ายยาว เล่าชะตากรรมของนักโทษการเมือง ม.112 ในระบอบสีน้ำเงิน บอกมรสุมนี้มันใหญ่ถูกจับแยกแดนไม่ให้อยู่ด้วยกัน จนถูกนักโทษคดีทั่วไปทำร้ายร่างกาย
title_cn: 律师安南达揭露第112条款政治犯在军政府时期的遭遇
summary_cn: 知名人权律师安南达(Ananda)发表长篇声明，讲述第112条款(王室诽谤罪)政治犯在「蓝色制度」(军政府统治时期)的悲惨经历。政治犯遭到隔离关押，甚至遭普通刑事犯人殴打。声明强调了该时期对言论自由和人权的严重侵犯。

title: เจอแล้ว “นาซาตาลา” เศร้าเพิ่งรู้ข่าวฮลุนเสียชีวิต ซึ้งใจ "หมอแทน" ส่งเสียเรียนแพทย์
desc: ตามหาเจอแล้ว “นาซาตาลา” เด็กหนุ่มชาวอัฟกานิสถาน เศร้าเพิ่งทราบข่าว “พี่ฮลุน” เสียชีวิต ซึ้งใจ “หมอแทน” อาสาสานต่อความตั้งใจ ส่งเสียเรียนแพทย์
title_cn: 失踪阿富汗少年纳萨塔拉已寻获 悲闻兄长身亡 医生坦医承诺助学医
summary_cn: 失踪的阿富汗少年纳萨塔拉(Nasatala)已被找到。少年悲痛地得知自己的哥哥已经去世。泰国医学教授坦医(Dr. Than)为此动容，承诺将继续支持纳萨塔拉完成医学学位的梦想。

title: จ่อยกระดับรัฐสู่การยืนยันตัวตนหลายชั้นภายใน 30 วัน หลังข้อมูลทะเบียนรถรั่วไหล
desc: “ภราดร” เผยข้อมูลทะเบียนรถรั่วไหล ไม่ได้ถูกเจาะระบบ แต่เกิดจากนำชื่อผู้ใช้และรหัสผ่านที่รั่วไหลไปค้นข้อมูล พบถูกค้นแล้ว 800 ราย จ่อยกระดับรัฐสู่การยืนยันตัวตนหลายชั้นภายใน 30 วัน
title_cn: 政府将在30天内升级为多层身份认证 因车辆登记数据泄露
summary_cn: 泰国车辆登记数据发生泄露，并非黑客入侵，而是通过外泄的用户名密码进行查询，已确认约800条记录被非法查询。政府计划在30天内将国家系统升级至多层身份认证机制，以增强安全防护。
desc_original: “ภราดร” เผยข้อมูลทะเบียนรถรั่วไหล ไม่ได้ถูกเจาะระบบ แต่เกิดจากนำชื่อผู้ใช้และรหัสผ่านที่รั่วไหลไปค้นข้อมูล พบถูกค้นแล้ว 800 ราย จ่อยกระดับรัฐสู่การยืนยันตัวตนหลายชั้นภายใน 30 วัน

desc: คนที่มีเครดิตการเงินที่ดี มีความเสี่ยงน้อยกว่าควรได้อัตราดอกเบี้ยที่ต่ำกว่าจนกลายเป็นที่มาของ Risk-based Pricing หรือ RBP แบงก์ไทยเริ่มใช้จริงแค่ไหน
title_cn: 泰国盘谷银行启用信用评分定价 差异化贷款利率
summary_cn: 泰国盘谷银行（TTB）正式启用信用评分在个人贷款和车辆抵押贷款中的应用，实施风险定价（RBP）模式。信用评级优异的客户将获得更低贷款利率，同时银行建立针对债务逃避者的管理系统。这反映泰国银行业逐步采纳国际风险定价标准的趋势。

title: 泰国潮州会馆举办《给阿嬷的情书》专场放映，重温华侨奋斗记忆
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月4日，泰国潮州会馆在 CentralWorld 举办电影《给阿嬷的情书》专场放映活动，现场氛围隆重热烈。中国驻泰王国特命全权大使张建卫、泰国文化部部长萨比达、正大集团资深董事长谢国民、泰国中华总商会主席林楚钦、泰国潮州会馆主席陈运金，以及在泰华人侨领、中资机构代表、电影主创团队一同参与。活动现场同步举办侨批展，吸引众多嘉宾驻足观看，反响空前热烈。 泰国潮州会馆主席陈运金表示，今天的活动不仅有电影《给阿嬷的情书》，还有展现潮汕先贤下南洋创业历史的短片，以及侨批文化与潮汕先贤奋斗史图片展。通过这些影像和图片，可以让大家进一步了解这段珍贵的历史，也让我们更加深刻地感受到中华文化在海外传承发展的力量。他说，电影《给阿嬷的情书》讲述的是一段跨越山海、延续半个世纪的守望与深情，也唤起了旅泰华侨华人共同的记忆。许多潮汕人的父辈、祖辈曾乘坐红头船来到暹罗，在异乡经历艰辛、努力创业，逐步站稳脚跟，同时始终牵挂着家乡。这种跨越时代、跨越国界的亲情与乡情，以及潮汕人身上所体现的担当、奋斗与深情，是值得我们世代传承的精神财富。 陈运金表示，虽然身在泰国，但广大华侨华人的心始终与家乡紧紧相连。泰国潮州会馆自成立以来，长期致力于团结乡亲、服务社会、弘扬中华优秀传统文化，为泰国经济社会发展和中泰友好交流作出了积极贡献，也是广大旅泰侨胞共同的家。未来，泰国潮州会馆将继续发挥百年侨社的优势，团结在泰华侨华人，弘扬中华优秀传统文化，促进中泰两国人民之间的交流与理解，为推动中泰友好、增进两国民心相通贡献力量。 泰国文化部部长萨比达在致辞中表示，泰中两国人民因深厚的文化纽带紧密相连，泰国文化部愿积极参与并全力支持以文化为桥梁的各类交流活动，推动两国关系持续深入发展。她分享道，自己曾向中国驻泰国大使请教中国提升国际影响力的核心抓手，大使给出的答案正是“文化”。她指出，文化不仅是连接两国人民的精神纽带，更成为中国发展的新动力，而电影《给阿嬷的情书》正是文化价值的生动诠释。影片讲述了泰国华裔及海外华人在泰生活奋斗的故事，承载着他们对故土的深情与感恩，展现了中华文化与泰国本土文化融合形成的独特生活方式与身份认同。 中国驻泰王国特命全权大使张建卫在致辞中表示，影片源于真实历史，“做人要有情有义”的核心理念贯穿始终。影片中，郑木生见义勇为、勤劳奋斗，谢南枝坚守承诺、写信养家，一个个鲜活的人物，生动诠释了海外华侨华人守望相助、亲如“家己人”的深厚情谊。张建卫特别提到，泰国潮州会馆多位乡贤在影片中友情客串，这一细节正是华侨华人与电影创作团队深厚情谊的体现，也是中泰友好的生动缩影。他表示，从正大集团获得中国改革开放后首张外资企业批准证书，到如今双方携手共谋发展，中泰两国始终保持着真诚合作、共同发展的伙伴关系，这正是“中泰一家亲”在新时代的最好注解。张建卫指出，长期以来，泰国华侨华人为促进中泰友

title: Thailand approves national committee for data centre oversight
desc: Thailand approves national committee for data centre oversight Legacy The Cabinet has approved the establishment of a national committee to oversee Thailand’s data centre industry following strong interest from foreign investors . Government spokesperson Ratchada Dhanadirek announced the decision today, August 5, saying the committee would be established under a draft Prime Minister’s Office regulation proposed by Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt. Photo via Thai Government According to the government, the move is intended to support Thailand’s digital economy strategy by creating clearer policies for the rapidly growing data centre sector, which has attracted significant interest from foreign investors . The committee will be chaired by a deputy prime minister appointed by the prime minister. The ministers of Digital Economy and Society, Interior, and Energy will serve as vice chairs, alongside 12 senior government officials and up to three experts appointed by the prime minister. Its responsibilities include proposing national policies, standards and operational guidelines for government agencies responsible for approving, licensing and providing services
title_cn: 泰国批准成立国家数据中心监管委员会
summary_cn: 泰国内阁已批准成立国家数据中心委员会以监督该产业发展。副总理帕空·尼帕帕农提议该委员会旨在支持泰国数字经济战略，为快速增长的数据中心行业制定明确政策，吸引外资进入。委员会由副总理担任主席，由数字经济和社会部、内政部、能源部长担任副主席，还包括12名高级政府官员及最多3名总理任命的专家。

title: Swedish woman wanted by Interpol arrested in Phuket
desc: Swedish woman wanted by Interpol arrested in Phuket Legacy A Swedish woman wanted on allegations of fraud against the public under an Interpol Red Notice was arrested in Phuket yesterday, August 4, after immigration police tracked her to the island . Police said the woman, identified only as Felicia, and more than 14 accomplices allegedly posed as employees of finance companies and banks in early 2022, making more than 163 fraudulent calls that persuaded victims to transfer money. The alleged scam caused losses exceeding 60 million baht. Photo via Phuket Info Centre Investigators located the Swedish national in Wichit, Phuket, at about 2pm yesterday before approaching and verifying her identity. Immigration records showed she entered Thailand through Ranong Customs Pier on January 31 on a tourist visa valid until March 31. She later obtained an extension from Phuket Immigration allowing her to remain in the country until August 31. Photo via Phuket Info Centre Phuket Info Centre reported that police have since revoked her permission to stay in Thailand. title: Everything you need to decide, and do, before relocating to Thailand in 2026

desc: Jurassic World Bangkok roars into its first anniversary at Asiatique Legacy Jurassic World: The Experience at Asiatique The Riverfront Destination is marking its first anniversary in Bangkok with a month-long programme of Chao Phraya riverfront activities throughout August 2026, including fireworks, free movie screenings, and complimentary ferry tickets for visitors. title: Saudi transgender woman reported missing in Bangkok
desc: Saudi transgender woman reported missing in Bangkok Legacy A Saudi Arabian transgender woman has been reported missing in Bangkok, prompting the Bangkok Community Help Foundation to appeal for public assistance in locating her after all contact was lost on July 29. The foundation shared the appeal on Facebook today, August 5, asking the public to help share the post and provide any information that could help locate the missing woman . According to the foundation, Nasser Alzahrani, whose name appears on her passport and other government identification documents, arrived in Thailand on May 29 and has been staying in Bangkok on a tourist visa for more than two months. Photo via Bangkok Community Help Foundation During her stay, she had reportedly been changing Airbnb accommodations approximately every five days. Her last known location was in Khlong Toei district, Bangkok. The foundation said her last contact with friends was at 2.19pm on July 29. Since then, all communication has stopped, both of her mobile phones have been switched off, and all of her WhatsApp numbers have become unreachable. Photo via Bangkok Community Help Foundation Friends have reportedly been trying to contact

title: 泰总理提3条重要路径，引领东盟走向强大未来
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月4日上午11点50分，泰国总理兼内政部部长阿努廷在印度尼西亚雅加达东盟秘书处（ASEC）发表了泰国对东盟未来愿景的演讲，东盟秘书处常驻代表及来自100多个国家和地区的外交官到场参与。阿努廷在演讲中提出了3条重要路径，旨在使东盟能够应对全球挑战、保持地区主导角色，并为民众创造切实成果。他强调，当今世界面临地缘政治、经济、技术和安全等相互关联的挑战，任何单一国家和地区都无法独自解决，区域挑战必须依靠区域答案。 阿努廷提出的3条重要路径如下： -第1条路径：加强区域主义 在日益分裂的世界里，东盟的团结和核心地位更加重要，协商一致和不干涉内政原则仍是重要基础，但应当灵活、适当地运用，让东盟在保持团结的同时，也能有效应对各种局势。 缅甸局势是一个明显的考验。“五点共识”是东盟处理缅甸局势的主要框架，泰国支持“适度、分阶段的重新接触”，重点是保持对话渠道、开放互动空间，并根据当地实际情况作出回应，推动具体进展。这一愿景似乎正朝着正确的方向发展，昨天，国际红十字委员会（ICRC）获准探望昂山素季，据报她身体健康，这是泰国一直希望看到的事情，同样希望将来还有更多积极的结果。 关于泰柬关系，目前双方同意恢复互信，为双边谈判开辟道路。泰国愿意与邻国开启关系新篇章，始终坚持通过和平的方式和国际法原则解决分歧，维护东盟团结和共同议程。 -第2条路径：增强抵御能力和应对波动的准备 东盟不能等危机发生后再解决，必须提前做好准备，包括加强供应链、能源和粮食安全，加快数字互联互通并提升技术能力等。同时，东盟应扩大与中等强国和全球南方国家的合作，增加选择，减少对单一来源的依赖，保持地区的战略自主。 -第3条路径：让东盟为民众带来可持续意义 东盟的成功必须用民众能感受到的结果来衡量，包括保护粮食和能源安全、应对跨境犯罪和威胁、创造就业和经济机会，以及培养年轻人技能以适应快速变化的数字经济与技术等。东盟必须加强机构和运行机制，让领导人的决策真正落到实处，惠及民众。 东盟是泰国共同创立的地区合作框架，自59年前签署《曼谷宣言》以来，它将一个曾经充满冲突的地区，转变为一个坚持规则、合作与对话的共同体。过去，泰国在东盟发展的多个阶段都发挥了重要作用，例如推动东盟自由贸易区（AFTA）、东盟地区论坛（ARF）和东盟政府间人权委员会（AICHR）的设立等。 这是泰国总理时隔17年后首次在东盟秘书处发表演讲，上一次是在2009年。阿努廷最后表示，明年东盟成立60周年将是重新确定地区方向的重要机会，泰国已准备好在关键转折点发挥积极作用，共同打造一个内部强大、团结、能应对变化、真正造福民众的东盟。泰国坚信，东盟未来是如此，这个未来也是大家共同创造的未来。 （编译：KA；来源：tna.mcot） The post 泰总理提3条重要路径，引领东盟走向强大未来 appeared first on
title_cn: 泰总理提3条重要路径，引领东盟走向强大未来
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷在雅加达东盟秘书处发表演讲，阐述东盟未来愿景。他提出三条重要路径：一、加强区域主义，强调团结和核心地位，采取「分阶段重新接触」处理缅甸局势，恢复泰柬互信；二、增强抵御能力，加强供应链、能源食品安全，扩大与全球南方国家合作，保持战略自主；三、为民众创造可持续成果，包括就业机会、安全和人才培养。这是总理17年来首次在东盟秘书处演讲。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月4日上午11点50分，泰国总理兼内政部部长阿努廷在印度尼西亚雅加达东盟秘书处（ASEC）发表了泰国对东盟未来愿景的演讲，东盟秘书处常驻代表及来自100多个国家和地区的外交官到场参与。阿努廷在演讲中提出了3条重要路径，旨在使东盟能够应对全球挑战、保持地区主导角色，并为民众创造切实成果。他强调，当今世界面临地缘政治、经济、技术和安全等相互关联的挑战，任何单一国家和地区都无法独自解决，区域挑战必须依靠区域答案。 阿努廷提出的3条重要路径如下： -第1条路径：加强区域主义 在日益分裂的世界里，东盟的团结和核心地位更加重要，协商一致和不干涉内政原则仍是重要基础，但应当灵活、适当地运用，让东盟在保持团结的同时，也能有效应对各种局势。 缅甸局势是一个明显的考验。“五点共识”是东盟处理缅甸局势的主要框架，泰国支持“适度、分阶段的重新接触”，重点是保持对话渠道、开放互动空间，并根据当地实际情况作出回应，推动具体进展。这一愿景似乎正朝着正确的方向发展，昨天，国际红十字委员会（ICRC）获准探望昂山素季，据报她身体健康，这是泰国一直希望看到的事情，同样希望将来还有更多积极的结果。 关于泰柬关系，目前双方同意恢复互信，为双边谈判开辟道路。泰国愿意与邻国开启关系新篇章，始终坚持通过和平的方式和国际法原则解决分歧，维护东盟团结和共同议程。 -第2条路径：增强抵御能力和应对波动的准备 东盟不能等危机发生后再解决，必须提前做好准备，包括加强供应链、能源和粮食安全，加快数字互联互通并提升技术能力等。同时，东盟应扩大与中等强国和全球南方国家的合作，增加选择，减少对单一来源的依赖，保持地区的战略自主。 -第3条路径：让东盟为民众带来可持续意义 东盟的成功必须用民众能感受到的结果来衡量，包括保护粮食和能源安全、应对跨境犯罪和威胁、创造就业和经济机会，以及培养年轻人技能以适应快速变化的数字经济与技术等。东盟必须加强机构和运行机制，让领导人的决策真正落到实处，惠及民众。 东盟是泰国共同创立的地区合作框架，自59年前签署《曼谷宣言》以来，它将一个曾经充满冲突的地区，转变为一个坚持规则、合作与对话的共同体。过去，泰国在东盟发展的多个阶段都发挥了重要作用，例如推动东盟自由贸易区（AFTA）、东盟地区论坛（ARF）和东盟政府间人权委员会（AICHR）的设立等。 这是泰国总理时隔17年后首次在东盟秘书处发表演讲，上一次是在2009年。阿努廷最后表示，明年东盟成立60周年将是重新确定地区方向的重要机会，泰国已准备好在关键转折点发挥积极作用，共同打造一个内部强大、团结、能应对变化、真正造福民众的东盟。泰国坚信，东盟未来是如此，这个未来也是大家共同创造的未来。 （编译：KA；来源：tna.mcot） The post 泰总理提3条重要路径，引领东盟走向强大未来 appeared first on

title: BofA views uneven recovery ahead
desc: The Thai economy is expected to miss the country's potential growth level of 2.5-3% over the next two years, says Bank of America (BofA), noting that the ongoing recovery remains "limited and uneven" while energy supply shocks and price volatility persist.
title_cn: 美国银行预警泰国经济复苏增长前景不均衡
summary_cn: 美国银行(BofA)发布报告称泰国经济未来两年增速可能低于潜在水平2.5%-3%。经济复苏「有限且不均衡」，能源供应冲击和价格波动仍对增长造成拖累。
desc_original: The Thai economy is expected to miss the country's potential growth level of 2.5-3% over the next two years, says Bank of America (BofA), noting that the ongoing recovery remains "limited and uneven" while energy supply shocks and price volatility persist.

title: Poor financial habits, high debt fuel mortgage rejections
desc: Homebuyers are increasingly being rejected for mortgages not because they lack income, but because poor financial habits and high household debt are making it harder to qualify for housing loans, according to Government Housing (GH) Bank.
title_cn: 财务不良和高负债推高购房贷款被拒率
summary_cn: 据泰国政府住房银行(GH Bank)，购房者贷款被拒的主因并非收入不足，而是不良财务习惯和高家庭债务导致贷款资格审批更加严格。
desc_original: Homebuyers are increasingly being rejected for mortgages not because they lack income, but because poor financial habits and high household debt are making it harder to qualify for housing loans, according to Government Housing (GH) Bank.

title: Advisors predict SET bull run for 1-2 years
desc: Thailand's bourse is expected to remain a bull market for 1-2 years, with the benchmark index projected to reach 1,700 points by the end of 2026, assuming economic and political fundamentals remain stable, says the Federation of Thai Capital Market Organizations (Fetco).
title_cn: 顾问预测泰国股市迎1-2年牛市周期
summary_cn: 泰国资本市场组织联合会(Fetco)预测，泰国证券交易所(SET)未来1-2年将保持牛市走势，基准指数有望年底前达到1700点，前提是经济和政治基本面保持稳定。
desc_original: Thailand's bourse is expected to remain a bull market for 1-2 years, with the benchmark index projected to reach 1,700 points by the end of 2026, assuming economic and political fundamentals remain stable, says the Federation of Thai Capital Market Organizations (Fetco).

title: Clicx pulls back over credit concerns
desc: Clicx Bank has tightened its loan approval process following a surge in applications from high-risk borrowers.
title_cn: Clicx银行因信用风险收紧贷款审批
summary_cn: Clicx银行因高风险借款申请激增，已采取措施严格把控贷款审批程序，防控信用风险。
desc_original: Clicx Bank has tightened its loan approval process following a surge in applications from high-risk borrowers.

title: Manhunt for cop killers widens
desc: A manhunt for six suspects accused of killing two police officers in Narathiwat has intensified after investigators found evidence suggesting they may have fled across the border.
title_cn: 追捕杀警嫌疑人范围扩大
summary_cn: 那拉提瓦 Narathiwat 发生警察遇害案，调查人员发现六名嫌疑人可能已逃往边界外，缉捕行动范围随之扩大。
desc_original: A manhunt for six suspects accused of killing two police officers in Narathiwat has intensified after investigators found evidence suggesting they may have fled across the border.

title: DSI moves against forex suspects
desc: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has formally charged four people, including People's Party (PP) list MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu and actor Rattapoom "Film" Tokongsup, in connection with an alleged online forex investment scheme.
title_cn: 特别调查部起诉外汇投资诈骗案嫌疑人
summary_cn: 泰国特别调查部（DSI）正式对四人提起诉讼，包括人民党（People's Party）国会议员 Pawoot Pongvitayapanu 和演员 Rattapoom「Film」Tokongsup，涉嫌参与非法在线外汇投资计划。
desc_original: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has formally charged four people, including People's Party (PP) list MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu and actor Rattapoom "Film" Tokongsup, in connection with an alleged online forex investment scheme.

title: Thai Honda holds prices amid cost pressures
desc: Thai Honda, a motorcycle manufacturer and distributor, is determined to keep its motorcycle prices stable despite mounting production costs driven by prolonged tensions in the Middle East.
title_cn: 泰国本田坚守摩托车价格 顶住成本压力
summary_cn: 摩托车制造商泰国本田 Thai Honda 在中东局势紧张导致生产成本上升的压力下，承诺维持摩托车价格稳定，以保护消费者利益。
desc_original: Thai Honda, a motorcycle manufacturer and distributor, is determined to keep its motorcycle prices stable despite mounting production costs driven by prolonged tensions in the Middle East.

title: Myanmar keen to boost ties
desc: Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing is scheduled to arrive in Thailand on Thursday for a two day visit, marking his first trip here since becoming a civilian leader.
title_cn: 缅甸总统将访泰加强双边关系
summary_cn: 缅甸总统敏昂莱（Min Aung Hlaing）定于周四抵达泰国，展开为期两天的访问，这是他成为文官领导人以来首次访问泰国，将进一步深化两国关系。
desc_original: Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing is scheduled to arrive in Thailand on Thursday for a two day visit, marking his first trip here since becoming a civilian leader.

title: Bangkok council chief issues warning over vote-card misuse
desc: The chair of the Bangkok Metropolitan Council (BMC) has warned that councillors found guilty of serious ethical violations over alleged vote-card misuse could face removal from office, as the council begins reviewing complaints over the alleged misconduct.
title_cn: 曼谷市政委员会主席就投票卡滥用发出警告
summary_cn: 曼谷市政委员会（BMC）主席警告，因投票卡滥用等严重道德违规被判有罪的议员可能面临撤销职务，委员会目前正在审查相关不当行为投诉。
desc_original: The chair of the Bangkok Metropolitan Council (BMC) has warned that councillors found guilty of serious ethical violations over alleged vote-card misuse could face removal from office, as the council begins reviewing complaints over the alleged misconduct.

title: พระบาทสมเด็จพระเจ้าอยู่หัว-สมเด็จพระนางเจ้าฯ พระบรมราชินี ทรงเปิดงาน “โครงการหลวง 57”
desc: จากที่พระบาทสมเด็จพระเจ้าอยู่หัว พระราชทานพระบรมราโชบายให้มูลนิธิโครงการหลวงดำเนินงานตามแนวทาง “สืบสาน รักษา ต่อยอด” เพื่อพัฒนางานโครงการหลวงให้มีความต่อเนื่อง
title_cn: 国王与皇后陛下主持揭幕皇家项目57
summary_cn: 泰国国王向皇家项目基金会 Royal Projects Foundation 拨款，明确指示基金会按照「继承、保护、发展」的方针推进工作。这一方向旨在传承皇家项目的核心使命、保护其既有成果，同时推动其持续创新发展，确保皇家项目的长期可持续性。
desc_original: จากที่พระบาทสมเด็จพระเจ้าอยู่หัว พระราชทานพระบรมราโชบายให้มูลนิธิโครงการหลวงดำเนินงานตามแนวทาง “สืบสาน รักษา ต่อยอด” เพื่อพัฒนางานโครงการหลวงให้มีความต่อเนื่อง

title: Fixes sought for missing person cases
desc: The Mirror Foundation has urged the Royal Thai Police (RTP) to overhaul Thailand's missing persons tracking system by adopting six key measures.
title_cn: 敦促改革失踪人员追踪系统
summary_cn: 镜像基金会 Mirror Foundation 向皇家泰国警察 Royal Thai Police RTP 提出建议，敦促其采取六项关键措施，全面改革和完善国内失踪人员追踪系统。这些措施旨在提高失踪案件的处理效率，增强警方对失踪人员信息的管理和协调能力。
desc_original: The Mirror Foundation has urged the Royal Thai Police (RTP) to overhaul Thailand's missing persons tracking system by adopting six key measures.

title: Builders say migrants needed
desc: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has met with representatives of the Thai Contractors Association under His Majesty the King's Patronage (TCA) to address the growing shortage of foreign workers.
title_cn: 建筑商呼吁需要引进外来劳工
summary_cn: 泰国劳动部长朱拉蓬·阿蒙维瓦与泰国承包商协会 Thai Contractors Association TCA 代表举行会议，共同探讨如何解决建筑行业日益严重的外来工人短缺问题，建筑企业认为引进外籍劳工对维持产业发展至关重要。
desc_original: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has met with representatives of the Thai Contractors Association under His Majesty the King's Patronage (TCA) to address the growing shortage of foreign workers.

title: Two agencies join data leak investigation
desc: Two government agencies have launched a joint investigation after vehicle registration and personal data were circulated online, although authorities say the source of the apparent leak has yet to be identified.
title_cn: 两政府机构联合调查数据泄露事件
summary_cn: 泰国两个政府机构启动联合调查，查处车辆登记信息和个人数据在网络上流传事件。这涉及泰国居民与外国人的个人隐私数据泄露，影响范围广泛。虽然有关部门已着手调查，但目前尚未确定数据泄露的具体源头和责任方。
desc_original: Two government agencies have launched a joint investigation after vehicle registration and personal data were circulated online, although authorities say the source of the apparent leak has yet to be identified.

title: สก.พรรคประชาชน นั่งประธานกมธ.วิสามัญถกงบประมาณกทม.ปี70 พร้อมคนนอกร่วมวง
desc: “ฉัตรชัย” สก.พรรคประชาชน นั่งประธานคณะกรรมการวิสามัญพิจารณางบฯกทม.ปี 2570 ดันการถ่ายทอดสดการประชุมพิจารณางบฯ สำเร็จ ดึง 7 คนนอกร่วมวงรวมถึง “ต่อศักดิ์ โชติมงคล”
title_cn: 人民党秘书长主持曼谷年度预算审议
summary_cn: 泰国人民党秘书长查特猜担任曼谷 2570 年度财政预算特别委员会主席。为增强会议透明度，会议实现全程直播。同时邀请包括托·肖蒂蒙贡在内的 7 名外部人士参与预算讨论，进一步开放政策制定过程。

desc: "ท่าอากาศยานสุวรรณภูมิ" ขออภัยปม รปภ. แสดงพฤติกรรมไม่เหมาะสม ระหว่างเข้าระงับเหตุกลุ่มผู้โดยสาร "แฟนคลับจีน" ก่อความวุ่นวาย - ฝ่าฝืนมาตรการรักษาความปลอดภัย พร้อมเผยคลิปแจงไทม์ไลน์วันเกิดเหตุ
title_cn: 素万那普机场为保安不当行为道歉 澄清中国粉丝群冲突时间线
summary_cn: 素万那普国际机场（Suvarnabhumi）为其保安人员的不当行为向公众道歉。事件起因于中国粉丝团在机场引发秩序混乱，保安在干预过程中存在违规行为。机场已发布视频澄清事件发生的具体时间线。

title: “ปลัด พม.” นำทัพไทยปักหมุดเนเธอร์แลนด์ เสนอตัวจัด “WorldPride 2030”
desc: ไทยโชว์ความพร้อมระดับโลก ร่วมงาน WorldPride Amsterdam 2026 เสนอตัวเป็นเจ้าภาพ “WorldPride 2030”
title_cn: 泰国总理率团参加阿姆斯特丹活动 申办2030年世界同志骄傲日
summary_cn: 泰国总理率领代表团参加2026年阿姆斯特丹世界同志骄傲日（WorldPride Amsterdam）活动，展示泰国的国际竞争力和开放政策。泰国正式申办2030年世界同志骄傲日主办权，并将其列为国家重点发展项目。

title: ศึกหวยอลเวงเดือด “ป้ายอม” ลั่นไม่ให้อภัย ด้าน “ป้ามณี” พร้อมสู้คดีเต็มที่
desc: ศึกหวยอลเวง 6 ล้านเดือด “ป้ายอม” ลั่นไม่ให้อภัย-ไม่แบ่งเงิน หลังเลยจุดประนีประนอม ด้าน “ป้ามณี” ยันเป็นหวยค้างแผง พร้อมสู้คดีเต็มที่
title_cn: 600万泰铢彩票纠纷升温 「阿姆婶」拒绝和解「玛尼阿姨」誓言诉讼到底
summary_cn: 围绕一张价值600万泰铢彩票的纠纷继续升温。当事人「阿姆婶」拒绝和解并表示不分享奖金，理由是已错过协商期限。对方「玛尼阿姨」坚持该彩票属于悬牌彩票（非正式游戏），并表示将采取法律手段解决纠纷。

title: กต. มอบ กงสุลดูแล ร่าง “ฮลุน โซโล่” เมื่อถึงไทย เร่งจอร์เจียเรื่องผลชันสูตร
desc: กระทรวงการต่างประเทศ แจ้งความคืบหน้า เตรียมส่งร่าง “ฮลุน โซโล่” กลับไทย มอบรักษาการอธิบดีกรมการกงสุลดูแลอำนวยความสะดวกเมื่อมาถึงประเทศ-เร่งรัดจอร์เจียเรื่องผลชันสูตร
title_cn: 外交部安排领事协助 「赫隆·索洛」遗体遣返泰国 催促格鲁吉亚尸检结果
summary_cn: 泰国外交部宣布进展情况，正在准备将「赫隆·索洛」的遗体遣返回国。一旦遗体抵达泰国，将由泰国领事馆主管部门负责提供协助和便利。同时，外交部正在积极督促格鲁吉亚当局加快尸检报告的提交。

desc: “อัครเดช” นำกรรมาธิการลงพื้นที่ราชบุรี ติดตามผลักดัน “บ้านโป่ง-โพธาราม-จอมบึง-สวนผึ้ง” ประกาศเป็นพื้นที่พิเศษเพื่อการท่องเที่ยวอย่างยั่งยืนของจังหวัด
title_cn: 乌督推动班泼、坡达兰、乔姆盇、蜜蜂公园成为旅游特区
summary_cn: 泰国议员乌督率领委员会赴北碧府（Ratchaburi）进行实地考察，推动将班泼（Ban Pho）、坡达兰（Tha Ram）、乔姆盇（Chom Bueng）和蜜蜂公园（Suan Phung）四个景点列入省级旅游特区。该计划旨在促进该地区的可持续旅游发展。

desc: สาวไทยเดินหน้าเอาผิด "หนุ่มต่างชาติ" ลวนลาม-ทำอนาจารบนเครื่องบิน เข้าให้ปากคำกับตำรวจ สน.ดอนเมือง พร้อมนำกางเกงที่ใส่วันเกิดเหตุมอบให้พนักงานสอบสวน ส่งตรวจเก็บดีเอ็นเอ
title_cn: 泰国女性控告外国男子在飞机上性骚扰，提交衣物供DNA检测
summary_cn: 一位泰国女性向唐人街警察局报案，指控一名外国男子在飞机上实施性骚扰和猥亵行为。受害人提交了事发当日穿着的衣物供调查人员采集DNA样本，以便作为法医证据协助破案。

title: Major drug money laundering suspect arrested in Tak
desc: A woman accused of laundering money for a major drug trafficking network was arrested in Mae Sot district of Tak province on Tuesday, with assets worth 150 million baht seized from her home.
title_cn: 泰国逮捕大型毒贩洗钱嫌疑人，查获资产1.5亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国执法部门在他府府（Tak）玛索区（Mae Sot）逮捕一名涉嫌为主要毒品贩运网络洗钱的女性嫌疑人。警方从其住宅查获总价值1.5亿泰铢的资产，该案涉及的毒品走私网络规模重大。

title: 130 million year old dinosaur fossil discovered in Chaiyaphum
desc: 130 million year old dinosaur fossil discovered in Chaiyaphum Legacy A new carnivorous dinosaur fossil , estimated to be more than 130 million years old, has been discovered in Chaiyaphum , making it more than 20 million years older than the famous Nagatitan fossil found in the province. The discovery was announced today, August 4, after 53 year old Yodsanya led a team of researchers to the site where he first found the fossil remains. The fossils were found in a cemetery west of Ban Mai Nong Daeng village in Ban Khwao district after the community used a backhoe to level the ground for the construction of a crematorium. Photo via Wirat Duangkaew Yodsanya collected several bone fragments and submitted them for examination, which confirmed they belonged to a dinosaur . Thairath reported that researchers have so far recovered more than 100 fossil pieces, including vertebrae, leg bones, joints, ankle bones and toe bones. Fossilised shark fin remains were also found at the site. The fossils will be taken to the research centre for further study while excavations continue to search for additional remains embedded beneath the limestone. title: Thailand disputes UN rapporteur’s claims on Thailand-Cambodia conflict
desc: Thailand disputes UN rapporteur’s claims on Thailand-Cambodia conflict Legacy Thailand has rejected claims that it initiated the conflict with Cambodia and disputed figures cited by United Nations Special Rapporteur Tom Andrews in his End of Mission Statement following a visit to Cambodia . According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) on August 1, Thailand reiterated that the conflict between the two countries was not initiated by Thailand, but resulted from what it described as “indiscriminate attacks” by Cambodia targeting civilian areas in Thailand . The MFA also disputed the Special Rapporteur’s reference to an alleged 650,000 internally displaced persons (IDPs) in Cambodia, saying part of the figure comprised Cambodians who had remained in areas Thailand opened as temporary shelters in the late 1970s as part of its humanitarian assistance. The ministry said those individuals did not return to Cambodia despite improvements in their situation and repeated protests lodged by Thailand with the Cambodian government. title: Thai doctor vows to continue late YouTuber’s support for Afghan teenager
desc: Thai doctor vows to continue late YouTuber’s support for Afghan teenager Legacy A Thai doctor pledged to fulfil the wish of late travel YouTuber Hlun Solo by supporting the education of an Afghan student the content creator befriended during one of his journeys. Hlun Solo, whose real name was Bawonthat Pengsuk, was confirmed dead at a hotel in Tbilisi, Georgia , on July 14. The cause of his death remains under investigation, while arrangements are being made to return his body to Thailand. Following his death, more people have revisited Hlun’s travel videos, with many viewers discovering his YouTube channel for the first time. Supporters have also returned to watch his content in tribute and to help generate income for his family, including his grandmother . One of the videos that attracted renewed attention documents Hlun’s visit to Afghanistan, where he met a young local named Naezatullaa. The teenager volunteered to guide Hlun and his travelling companion and later welcomed them into his family home. title: Looking for the best family resort near Phuket Airport? Here’s why Mai Khao should be on your list
desc: Looking for the best family resort near Phuket Airport? Here’s why Mai Khao should be on your list Legacy For many families, the perfect holiday starts with a simple question: Where should we stay in Phuket that’s close to the airport but still feels like a tropical escape? While areas like Patong, Kata and Karon are well known for their lively atmosphere, travellers looking for a quieter experience are increasingly choosing Mai Khao Beach. Located on Phuket’s northwest coast, this stretch of coastline offers wide sandy beaches, fewer crowds and convenient access to Phuket International Airport, making it an attractive destination for families travelling with children. title: Court jails Chinese man 46 years over weapons cache in Chon Buri
desc: Court jails Chinese man 46 years over weapons cache in Chon Buri Legacy A Thai court sentenced Chinese national , Sun Mingchen , to 46 years in prison for illegally possessing a large cache of weapons at his property in Chon Buri. The motive behind the extensive stockpile is still under investigation. The case emerged in May after Sun crashed his car in Sattahip district. Police responding to the accident found a Glock 26 pistol and ammunition inside the vehicle, prompting a wider investigation. Officers later searched his home and seized a large quantity of military-grade equipment , including C4 explosives, M16 and M4 firearms, anti-personnel grenades, bulletproof vests, chemical masks, radio signal jammers, remote-control transceivers and ammunition. The scale of the seizure raised questions about the purpose of the collection, but investigators have yet to determine a motive. Photo via Thai PBS The investigation also found that Sun held more than one nationality and had travelled between Thailand and Cambodia. title: American YouTuber leaves Thailand to Vietnam after six years: are his reasons fair?
desc: American YouTuber leaves Thailand to Vietnam after six years: are his reasons fair? Legacy Ben Marriott, the creator behind the YouTube channel The Borderless Office, has left Thailand after living here for six years and relocated to Ho Chi Minh City. His video setting out eight reasons for the move has circulated widely in expat communities, and it is worth engaging with seriously rather than dismissing or cheering uncritically. His central argument is that the gap between what living in Thailand costs and what it offers has narrowed. That is a defensible position, and several of his specific claims hold up. What he says, and what the data shows On corruption and regulatory uncertainty, he is on solid ground. Thailand scored 33 out of 100 in the 2025 Corruption Perceptions Index, ranking 116th of 182 countries and its lowest result in nearly two decades. Within ASEAN, Thailand now sits below Vietnam on that measure. On economic growth, the comparison broadly holds. Vietnam grew 8.02% in 2025. Thailand grew 2.4%, and the NESDC forecasts 1.5 to 2.5% for 2026 . For a remote worker building a career in technology and digital business, the energy of a faster-growing economy is a real,

title: Thailand now requires birth certificates for children travelling abroad
desc: Thailand now requires birth certificates for children travelling abroad Legacy Thai nationals under 18 travelling abroad must now present additional documents during departure immigration checks under new travel rules introduced in Thailand. The new measure, announced by the departure immigration division at Suvarnabhumi Airport on July 8, aims to streamline immigration procedures while strengthening safeguards against children being taken out of Thailand without the consent of their parents or legal guardians. Previously, Thai children under the age of 18 could travel overseas using only a valid passport. Under the new requirements, additional documentation is now required during departure immigration checks. Parents, guardians or other accompanying adults travelling with a child under 18 must present supporting documents to immigration officers. These include the child’s birth certificate , either the original, a copy or an electronic image, together with a consent letter from the father and/or mother issued by a government agency. Thai birth certificate sample | Photo via Royal Thai Embassy, London In a separate rule change, the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT)

title_cn: 高科技投资「双刃剑」 央行警示水电消耗巨大就业贡献微
summary_cn: 泰国央行总裁指出，外资投资AI、数据中心、云服务等高科技项目面临挑战。虽能带来资金注入，但消耗巨大水电资源，对本地就业创造和采购拉动作用有限。央行认为这类投资效益不如预期，总体来看经济贡献与资源消耗不成比例，值得政策层进一步评估优化。
desc_original: ผู้ว่าธปท. ชี้ ต่างชาติลงทุน AI-ดาต้าเซ็นเตอร์-คลาวด์เซอร์วิส เป็น “ดาบสองคม” เพราะใช้น้ำ-ไฟฟ้ามหาศาล แต่จ้างงานคนไทย และใช้สินค้าในประเทศน้อย

title: Pattaya operators back airport rail link
desc: Tourism operators in Pattaya say that the rail link connecting the three airports, regardless of its speed, remains essential for boosting traffic at U-tapao Airport, as tourism in the eastern region alone cannot attract the large number of visitors needed to fulfil the airport's planned capacity.
title_cn: 芭提雅业者力挺三机场铁路连线
summary_cn: 芭提雅旅游从业者表示，连接三座国际机场的铁路项目对促进乌塔堡机场（U-tapao）客运增长至关重要。东部地区旅游资源难以单独满足该机场的规划容量，铁路连接被视为必要基础设施。无论速度如何，该项目将有助于解决机场容量利用不足问题，促进区域旅游发展。
desc_original: Tourism operators in Pattaya say that the rail link connecting the three airports, regardless of its speed, remains essential for boosting traffic at U-tapao Airport, as tourism in the eastern region alone cannot attract the large number of visitors needed to fulfil the airport's planned capacity.

title: Chevron launches high-speed boat to transport oil workers
desc: Chevron Thailand Exploration and Production is enhancing its offshore petroleum operations by deploying the world's first trimaran crew vessel to transport workers to drilling platforms in the Gulf of Thailand.
title_cn: 雪佛龙投入全球首艘三体船运送泰湾油气工人
summary_cn: 雪佛龙泰国勘探与生产公司部署全球首艘三体高速工作船，用于运送工人往返泰国湾离岸钻井平台。这艘先进船舶的投入标志着公司海上油气开采技术的创新升级。该举措改进工人运送效率，提升海上作业安全性和便利性，体现了油气行业的持续技术进步。
desc_original: Chevron Thailand Exploration and Production is enhancing its offshore petroleum operations by deploying the world's first trimaran crew vessel to transport workers to drilling platforms in the Gulf of Thailand.

title: Central bank schemes set to expand SME lending
desc: The Bank of Thailand expects its two targeted lending schemes to increase lending to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) by 130 billion baht by the end of next year, as overall bank lending has begun to recover.
title_cn: 央行贷款计划拟扩大中小企业融资规模
summary_cn: 泰国央行预计通过两项针对性贷款计划，在明年底前为中小企业增加1300亿泰铢贷款额度。随着整体银行贷款恢复增长，这些政策举措有望显著改善泰国中小企业的融资环境。对经营困难的小型企业和创业者而言，扩大性融资支持政策具有重要实际意义。
desc_original: The Bank of Thailand expects its two targeted lending schemes to increase lending to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) by 130 billion baht by the end of next year, as overall bank lending has begun to recover.

title: Dig uncovers lost wall section
desc: NAKHON RATCHASIMA: Archaeologists have uncovered a long-lost eastern section of the Korat city wall, a major discovery not seen in more than two decades.
title_cn: 那空叻差西玛（Nakhon Ratchasima）失落城墙东段重见天日
summary_cn: 考古人员在那空叻差西玛发现了失落超过二十年的古城墙东段，这是该地区二十多年来的重大考古发现。该城墙遗迹的出土为研究古代城市建筑和防御体系提供了宝贵的考古证据，对于了解当地历史文化具有重要学术价值。
desc_original: NAKHON RATCHASIMA: Archaeologists have uncovered a long-lost eastern section of the Korat city wall, a major discovery not seen in more than two decades.

title: Bangkok launches quantum tech hub
desc: Thailand has taken a significant step towards the quantum technology era with the launch of Quantum Club Thailand, a national collaboration platform designed to position the country as a contributor to the global quantum technology landscape.
title_cn: 泰国启动「量子俱乐部」量子科技中心
summary_cn: 泰国正式推出「量子俱乐部泰国」（Quantum Club Thailand）国家级合作平台，这是该国向量子技术时代迈进的重要举措。该平台旨在推动泰国成为全球量子技术的重要贡献者，构建本地量子技术生态体系，促进产学研协作与人才培养。
desc_original: Thailand has taken a significant step towards the quantum technology era with the launch of Quantum Club Thailand, a national collaboration platform designed to position the country as a contributor to the global quantum technology landscape.

title: Health ministry steps up weed enforcement rules
desc: The Ministry of Public Health has stepped up enforcement of cannabis rules, revealing the results of operations conducted since October.
title_cn: 泰国卫生部加强大麻管制执法
summary_cn: 泰国公共卫生部加强了对大麻相关法规的执法力度，并公布了自去年10月以来的执法行动成果。这一举措旨在规范大麻产业发展，打击非法使用和交易，维护公众健康与社会秩序。在泰外国人应了解相关法规以避免触法。
desc_original: The Ministry of Public Health has stepped up enforcement of cannabis rules, revealing the results of operations conducted since October.

title: PP accused of proxy voting
desc: The Democrat Party on Monday called for an investigation into alleged proxy voting by People's Party councillors during a recent Bangkok Metropolitan Council (BMC) meeting, saying it would file a complaint with the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC).
title_cn: 民主党指控人民党议员代理投票
summary_cn: 民主党周一要求对人民党议员在曼谷都市评议会（Bangkok Metropolitan Council）最近会议中的涉嫌代理投票行为进行调查，并表示将向国家反腐败委员会（NACC）提交投诉。此举反映了泰国政坛对议会投票程序透明性和合法性的高度关注。
desc_original: The Democrat Party on Monday called for an investigation into alleged proxy voting by People's Party councillors during a recent Bangkok Metropolitan Council (BMC) meeting, saying it would file a complaint with the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC).

title: PP MP, actor, answer DSI summons in forex case
desc: People's Party (PP) list-MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu and actor Rattapoom "Film" Tokongsup separately reported to the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) on Monday to acknowledge charges in connection with an alleged illegal foreign exchange (forex) trading scheme.
title_cn: 人民党议员与演员就外汇交易案接受特调部传讯
summary_cn: 人民党名单议员帕乌特·庞维塔亚潘（Pawoot Pongvitayapanu）与演员拉塔普·托孔苏普（Rattapoom Tokongsup）周一分别向特别调查部（DSI）报到应诉，就涉嫌非法外汇交易计划案接受调查。该案件涉及知名政界人物和娱乐圈人士，引起社会广泛关注。
desc_original: People's Party (PP) list-MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu and actor Rattapoom "Film" Tokongsup separately reported to the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) on Monday to acknowledge charges in connection with an alleged illegal foreign exchange (forex) trading scheme.

title: Korrawee to sue iLaw director
desc: Bhumjaithai MP for Ang Thong Korrawee Prisananantakul on Monday authorised his lawyer to file a defamation complaint against iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont over allegations linking him to the alleged Senate election collusion case.
title_cn: 攀牙县议员科罗威起诉iLaw主任涉参议院选举勾结案
summary_cn: 不让步党（Bhumjaithai）安通府议员科罗威普里萨南授权其律师对泰国民间法律组织iLaw主任英奇普提起诽谤诉讼。此举系对其涉嫌参与参议院选举勾结案的指控进行回应，两方因参议院选举相关争议产生纠纷。
desc_original: Bhumjaithai MP for Ang Thong Korrawee Prisananantakul on Monday authorised his lawyer to file a defamation complaint against iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont over allegations linking him to the alleged Senate election collusion case.

title: PP rules out future cooperation with BJT
desc: The People's Party (PP) has learned its lesson from supporting Anutin Charnvirakul's bid for the premiership, deputy leader Sirikanya Tansakun said on Monday, apologising to the public and ruling out future cooperation with the ruling Bhumjaithai Party (BJT).
title_cn: 人民党宣布排除与不让步党未来合作
summary_cn: 人民党（People's Party）副主席西里坚雅表示，该党从支持副总理阿努廷竞争总理职位的决定中吸取教训，向公众致歉，并宣布排除与执政的不让步党（Bhumjaithai）未来合作的可能性，反映出泰国政治联盟格局的重大变化。
desc_original: The People's Party (PP) has learned its lesson from supporting Anutin Charnvirakul's bid for the premiership, deputy leader Sirikanya Tansakun said on Monday, apologising to the public and ruling out future cooperation with the ruling Bhumjaithai Party (BJT).

title: RFD widens Phuket land crackdown
desc: The Royal Forestry Department (RFD) on Monday expanded its crackdown on alleged forest encroachment in Phuket, targeting eight locations as part of the government's "Phuket Model" policy to reclaim illegally occupied land.
title_cn: 皇家林业部加强普吉岛非法占林整治
summary_cn: 泰国皇家林业部周一宣布在普吉岛扩大打击非法森林侵占行动，锁定8处地点进行集中整治。此举系政府「普吉模式」（Phuket Model）政策框架的重要组成，旨在收回被非法占据的国有林地，推进环境保护和资源管理工作。
desc_original: The Royal Forestry Department (RFD) on Monday expanded its crackdown on alleged forest encroachment in Phuket, targeting eight locations as part of the government's "Phuket Model" policy to reclaim illegally occupied land.

title: Movie revenue poised to climb this year
desc: The outlook for the film industry in the second half of the year is promising, according to leading Thai movie studio GDH 559 Co Ltd.
title_cn: 泰国电影业今年收入有望上升
summary_cn: 泰国领先电影制作公司GDH 559表示，电影行业在下半年前景乐观，对年度收入增长保持积极预期。该声明反映出泰国电影产业的恢复动能，暗示影视内容消费和投资热情正在升温，对从业者和投资方释放利好信号。
desc_original: The outlook for the film industry in the second half of the year is promising, according to leading Thai movie studio GDH 559 Co Ltd.

title: PM blasts UN border report
desc: Thailand has rejected a UN special rapporteur's report estimating that 650,000 Cambodians were internally displaced during recent border clashes, saying the findings relied on one-sided information and failed to include Thailand's perspective.
title_cn: 泰国总理批驳联合国边界报告
summary_cn: 泰国总理拒绝接受联合国特别报告员关于近期泰柬边界冲突导致约65万柬埔寨人流离失所的报告。泰国政府认为该报告过度依赖单方面信息，未能充分纳入泰国立场，缺乏平衡性和公正性。此事反映两国围绕人道主义问题的外交分歧。
desc_original: Thailand has rejected a UN special rapporteur's report estimating that 650,000 Cambodians were internally displaced during recent border clashes, saying the findings relied on one-sided information and failed to include Thailand's perspective.

title: Govt considers extending co-payment scheme
desc: The government has not ruled out extending the Thais Help Thais Plus co-payment scheme following positive public feedback.
title_cn: 政府考虑延续「泰国人帮助泰国人Plus」医疗共付计划
summary_cn: 泰国政府在收到公众积极反馈后，正考虑延长「泰国人帮助泰国人Plus」医疗共付计划。该计划是政府医疗保障的重要举措，旨在减轻患者就医费用负担，此举反映政府对公众卫生的持续关注。
desc_original: The government has not ruled out extending the Thais Help Thais Plus co-payment scheme following positive public feedback.

title: Health fair contracts prompt questions
desc: A former doctors' group leader has questioned whether a Public Health Ministry event in Phetchabun was deliberately split into four procurement contracts worth more than 1.4 million baht to avoid procurement rules.
title_cn: 公卫部门健康展览会合同引发质疑
summary_cn: 一位医生协会前领导人质疑泰国公共卫生部在碧差汶府（Phetchabun）举办的卫生展览会是否故意将140万泰铢的采购合同拆分为四份，以规避采购规则。此举涉及政府采购透明度问题，引发对公共资金使用的关注。
desc_original: A former doctors' group leader has questioned whether a Public Health Ministry event in Phetchabun was deliberately split into four procurement contracts worth more than 1.4 million baht to avoid procurement rules.

title: “นายกฯ อนุทิน” เตรียมเหินฟ้าขึ้น F-16 ตรวจชายแดน พร้อมให้โอวาททหาร
desc: กองทัพอากาศจัดใหญ่ เชิญ “นายกฯ อนุทิน” เหินฟ้าขึ้น F-16 กองบิน 1 โคราช ตรวจชายแดน พร้อมให้โอวาททหาร
title_cn: 总理阿努廷乘F-16战机视察边境
summary_cn: 泰国空军邀请总理阿努廷（Anutin）乘坐F-16战机从呵叻（Korat）第一空军基地视察边界地区。此次活动还包括空军阅兵式，展示泰国军事力量，强调对国家边境安全的重视。
desc_original: กองทัพอากาศจัดใหญ่ เชิญ “นายกฯ อนุทิน” เหินฟ้าขึ้น F-16 กองบิน 1 โคราช ตรวจชายแดน พร้อมให้โอวาททหาร

desc: “อาจารย์ ม.ศิลปากร” โร่ร้อง “ประชาธิปัตย์” ถูกสกัด ไม่ให้ร่วม “โครงการช่วย SME สสว.” “กรณ์” แฉพิรุธ เปิดช่อง“กลุ่มอิทธิพลคนนอก” ด้าน สสว.ออกเอกสารชี้แจงทำทุกขั้นตอนโปร่งใส
title_cn: 泰国美术大学教师称民主党遭排斥中小企业帮扶项目
summary_cn: 泰国美术大学教师公开指责政府将民主党（Democratic Party）排斥在中小企业帮扶项目之外，并暗示外部势力参与其中。中小企业促进局随后发表声明，强调项目所有步骤均按程序透明进行。此事涉及政党政治与经济政策的交集。

desc: นายกฯอนุทิน ร่วมเป็นสักขีพยานพิธีมอบเครื่องหมายเชิดชูเกียรติแก่ประธานาธิบดีอินโดนีเซีย สะท้อนมิตรภาพกองทัพไทย–อินโดนีเซีย และความร่วมมือด้านความมั่นคงที่แน่นแฟ้น
title_cn: 总理阿努廷见证向印尼总统授勋仪式
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷（Anutin）出席向印尼总统授勋的仪式并担任见证人。该勋章授予仪式凸显泰国与印尼军方的深厚友谊以及双国在安全与防务领域的密切合作，进一步巩固两国战略伙伴关系。

title: ไล่ล่ารถขนยาเสพติด เจอซุกไอซ์กว่า 500 กก. ผู้ต้องหารับได้ค่าจ้าง 5 แสน
desc: ที่ชัยภูมิ เจ้าหน้าที่สนธิกำลัง ไล่ล่ารถขนยาเสพติด นำเข้าจากประเทศเพื่อนบ้าน ลำเลียงเข้ากรุงเทพฯ รวบ 5 ผู้ต้องหา เจอซุกไอซ์ 528 กก. สารภาพได้ค่าจ้าง 5 แสน
title_cn: 泰缉毒破获冰毒528公斤 5嫌疑人因走私获酬50万
summary_cn: 泰国联合缉毒部队日前在差也府（Chaiyaphum）追捕一辆贩毒车，成功缴获冰毒528公斤，抓获5名嫌疑人。据供述，这批毒品从邻国非法运入泰国，计划运往曼谷销售。其中一名嫌疑人承认因参与走私获得50万泰铢酬金。此案反映泰国面临的跨境贩毒问题日益严峻。
desc_original: ที่ชัยภูมิ เจ้าหน้าที่สนธิกำลัง ไล่ล่ารถขนยาเสพติด นำเข้าจากประเทศเพื่อนบ้าน ลำเลียงเข้ากรุงเทพฯ รวบ 5 ผู้ต้องหา เจอซุกไอซ์ 528 กก. สารภาพได้ค่าจ้าง 5 แสน

title_cn: 泰陆军确认边境掩体工程完成投入使用
summary_cn: 泰国陆军司令部日前确认，位于尖竹汶府（Chanthaburi）至达府（Trat）边境防线的建设工程已全面完成，100多个防御掩体已全部竣工并投入使用，各掩体结构牢固、安全运作无虞。军方同时否认近期在网络流传的某些边境建筑图片为其部门所建工程，强调防线建设按计划推进。

title: Nearly 6,000 civil servants to lose jobs after exam fraud
desc: The discovery of civil service exam fraud is expected to cost 5,925 local government employees their jobs this month, Deputy Interior Minister Worasit Liangprasit said on Monday.
title_cn: 泰国公务员考试舞弊案 6000名地方员工本月失业

title: Turkish-German man apologises after his social detox triggers missing complaint
desc: Turkish-German man apologises after his social detox triggers missing complaint Legacy A Turkish-German tourist , who was reported missing in Chiang Mai was found safe yesterday, July 2, telling police he had deliberately disconnected from family and friends as part of a nine-day social media detox . The missing tourist case in Chiang Mai emerged after 32 year old Ali Karakoyunlu’s sister sought help from his former girlfriend, Suppanat Essie, who shared a missing person appeal on social media in an effort to locate him. According to the family, Ali arrived in Bangkok from Japan at about 2pm on July 20 before travelling by train to Chiang Mai the following day. Relatives said they lost contact with him on July 23. Suppanat said she and Ali’s younger sister tried to reach him through Facebook, Instagram, LINE, Telegram and his Thai mobile number. She said the phone repeatedly switched on and off, leading them to suspect it had been stolen. title: Hiroshi Nagai’s Summer Dreaming exhibition brings City Pop art to Bangkok
desc: Hiroshi Nagai’s Summer Dreaming exhibition brings City Pop art to Bangkok Legacy The Royal Orchid Sheraton Riverside Hotel Bangkok, in collaboration with River City Bangkok, SYNCA Creations, Kafae Dam, and MUSIC BOOM, is hosting “ Hiroshi Nagai: Summer Dreaming ,” the first-ever solo exhibition in Thailand by the Japanese artist. Nagai is widely regarded as the founding figure of the “City Pop” visual style that defined Japan’s 1980s music scene. During Japan’s 1980s economic boom, Nagai’s album cover art shaped the look of a generation. His work paired bright, breezy imagery with the synth-driven sound of City Pop, turning vinyl covers into art in their own right. Nagai’s paintings depict a dreamlike, sun-drenched world inspired by American landscapes reimagined through a Japanese lens. Sapphire-blue pools, palm trees and mid-century architecture appear under clear skies, rendered in sharp lines and saturated colour. The scenes are deliberately empty of people, leaving space for viewers to imagine themselves within them. The exhibition marks the first time Nagai’s work has been shown in Thailand.
