title: Norwegian man caught on video assaulting, making death threats in Bangkok
desc: Norwegian man caught on video assaulting, making death threats in Bangkok Legacy A Norwegian man is wanted for assaulting a Thai man and making death threats on a skywalk near Bangkok International Trade and Exhibition Centre (BITEC). The assault took place at about 8.30am on August 1 on the elevated walkway linking Udom Suk BTS Station, Bang Na BTS Station and the BITEC. The victim, 29 year old Ton, and his 28 year old friend, Wai, sought assistance from the Saimai Survive Foundation after filing a complaint with Bang Na Police Station. They said they wanted help following up on the investigation as the suspect had not been apprehended. Ton said he was walking to work, as he had done regularly for more than three years, when he heard the foreign man shouting. He initially ignored the disturbance but alleged that the man suddenly approached and kicked him in the arm, causing his mobile phone to fall to the ground. title: Russian volunteer interpreter lends voice to murder case
desc: Russian volunteer interpreter lends voice to murder case Legacy A 22 year old Russian woman who has been volunteering as an interpreter in a Chon Buri murder case, in which two Russian siblings were killed , grew up in Thailand and speaks the language fluently. She describes her volunteer work as something that has given her real value and experience. Varvara Davydova has lived in Thailand since she was eight years old and speaks Thai fluently. She graduated from the Faculty of Law at Sripatum University’s Chon Buri campus with first-class honours and first worked as an interpreter at the age of 15. Police have accused two men , Thongchai, or “Thong,” 39 year old, and Thachana, or “Pong,” 43 year old, of posing as officials to defraud the two Russian siblings before robbing and killing them and burying the bodies, according to the police allegation. The case has not yet gone to court. Davydova, who is mostly based at the Pattaya Immigration Bureau, has assisted with a number of cases as a volunteer interpreter over the years. title: Isan Creative Festival 2026 wraps up, cementing the Northeast’s creative economy push
desc: Isan Creative Festival 2026 wraps up, cementing the Northeast’s creative economy push Legacy The Isan Creative Festival 2026 (ISANCF2026) has officially concluded after nine days, but organisers say its work driving the Northeast’s creative economy is far from over. The festival drew 304,430 visitors from Thailand and abroad across more than 200 programmes at four venues in Khon Kaen and other creative spaces around the region. summary_cn: 针对退休年龄驾驶者的安全驾驶指南。介绍视力衰退、身体机能下降、反应时间延长等老龄化生理变化，提供眼睛检查清单和驾驶技巧调整建议，帮助高龄驾驶者安全上路，规避风险。

title: Ministry looks into Mor Prom data discrepancies
desc: An investigation into data verification and system errors within the Mor Prom mobile app will be mounted after more than 10,000 users lodged complaints regarding inaccurate medical records, the Ministry of Public Health says.
title_cn: 卫生部调查「莫普罗」医疗应用数据不一致问题
summary_cn: 泰国卫生部启动对「莫普罗」（Mor Prom）医疗移动应用的调查。超过1万用户投诉该应用中的医疗记录存在数据错误和系统问题，卫生部将着手调查数据验证流程和系统漏洞，以恢复用户对医疗记录准确性的信心。
desc_original: An investigation into data verification and system errors within the Mor Prom mobile app will be mounted after more than 10,000 users lodged complaints regarding inaccurate medical records, the Ministry of Public Health says.

title: SSI มุ่งเป้าดันเหล็กสีเขียว
desc: SSI จัดทาวน์ฮอลล์ประกาศทิศทางธุรกิจ มุ่งเป้าปี 69 ดันเหล็กสีเขียว เสริมความเชื่อมั่นพนักงานร่วมขับเคลื่อนองค์กร
title_cn: SSI公司2026年聚焦绿色钢铁战略发展
summary_cn: 泰国SSI公司召开镇城市大会公布2026年度业务方向。公司将重点推进绿色钢铁领域的发展，强化员工的组织凝聚力和信心，推动公司可持续发展战略的落地实施。
desc_original: SSI จัดทาวน์ฮอลล์ประกาศทิศทางธุรกิจ มุ่งเป้าปี 69 ดันเหล็กสีเขียว เสริมความเชื่อมั่นพนักงานร่วมขับเคลื่อนองค์กร

title: Thais urged to stay alert  for war risk
desc: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has urged Thai nationals in the Middle East to remain vigilant as regional tensions continue to escalate and the risk of further military attacks increases.
title_cn: 泰国外交部敦促驻中东国民警惕地区战争风险
summary_cn: 泰国外交部向驻中东地区的泰国国民发出警告。由于该地区局势持续升级、军事冲突风险加剧，外交部敦促在当地的泰国人保持高度警觉并采取防范措施，以确保人身安全。
desc_original: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has urged Thai nationals in the Middle East to remain vigilant as regional tensions continue to escalate and the risk of further military attacks increases.

title: GWM ขึ้นแท่นแบรนด์รถรายแรก ผลิตชดเชยครบตามเงื่อนไข EV 3.5
desc: GWM (Thailand) สร้างประวัติศาสตร์หน้าใหม่ ประกาศความสำเร็จแบรนด์รถยนต์รายแรกของจีนที่ผลิตชดเชยครบตามเงื่อนไขมาตรการ EV 3.5 จากฐานผลิตในประเทศไทย
title_cn: GWM 成首个中国品牌完成电动车「3.5」补偿产量条件
summary_cn: 中国汽车品牌 GWM（长城汽车）泰国公司日前宣布创造历史，成为首个在泰国本地制造基地完成符合泰国「EV 3.5」电动车补偿产量条件的中国车企。这一成就标志着 GWM 在泰国电动车市场的战略性突破，也反映了泰国汽车产业在政府电动化政策推动下的快速转型和升级。业界普遍认为，这为其他中国车企在泰国市场的发展树立了新的标杆。
desc_original: GWM (Thailand) สร้างประวัติศาสตร์หน้าใหม่ ประกาศความสำเร็จแบรนด์รถยนต์รายแรกของจีนที่ผลิตชดเชยครบตามเงื่อนไขมาตรการ EV 3.5 จากฐานผลิตในประเทศไทย

title: กขค.ปัดฝุ่น 3 ไกด์ไลน์รุกเข้ม ย้ำลั่นดูแลการแข่งขันให้เสรีเป็นธรรมทันโลก
desc: กขค.ปัดฝุ่นไกด์ไลน์แพลตฟอร์มดิจิทัล-ค้าส่งค้าปลีก-บริการจัดส่งออนดีมานด์ เปิดรับฟังความคิดเห็น หวังกำกับดูแลการแข่งขันทางการค้าให้เสรี เป็นธรรม และสอดคล้องกับบริบทการค้าที่เปลี่ยนแปลงไป
title_cn: 商务委员会发布 3 项指南确保电商竞争公平透明
summary_cn: 泰国商务委员会发布关于数字平台、批发零售及按需配送服务的三项新指南，旨在进一步规范这些快速发展的行业。委员会开放征求公众意见，希望在适应当今商业环境快速变化的同时，维护市场竞争的自由、公平和透明，确保相关政策框架与国际标准相符合。这体现了泰国对于数字经济时代商业监管的前瞻性思考。

title: Co-payment scheme a B86.4bn hit
desc: The Thais Help Thais Plus 60/40 co-payment scheme generated more than 86.4 billion baht in its first two months, the government said on Sunday.
title_cn: 「泰国帮泰国」60/40 共付计划两月收入 864 亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国政府公布「泰国帮泰国 Plus」60/40 共付医疗方案的首轮成果，该方案在推出后的首两个月内即产生了超过 864 亿泰铢的收入。该医疗共付方案是泰国医保体系改革的重要举措，旨在通过政府与民众共同承担医疗费用的方式，提高医保覆盖面并保障公共卫生资源的可持续性。这一成绩说明该方案得到了广泛认可。
desc_original: The Thais Help Thais Plus 60/40 co-payment scheme generated more than 86.4 billion baht in its first two months, the government said on Sunday.

title: นวัตกรรมครีมซอง 6 in 1 สารสกัดจากแตงโม บำรุง กันแดด เบส รองพื้น ครบจบในซองเดียว
desc: เคยไหม? ตื่นเช้ามาต้องโบกครีมบำรุง ตามด้วยกันแดด ลงเบสปรับสีผิว แล้วยังต้องลงรองพื้นเพื่อปกปิด กว่าจะได้ออกจากบ้าน หน้าก็หนาเยิ้ม แถมระหว่างวันยังต้องเจอน้ำ เจอเหงื่อ สุดท้าย พังเป็นคราบ!
title_cn: 创新 6-in-1 西瓜护肤霜一支搞定全妆容
summary_cn: 一款新推出的 6 合 1 护肤产品采用西瓜精华提取物，集护肤、防晒、肤色修正和粉底四大功能于单一产品中，旨在简化消费者的日常化妆步骤。这款创新产品针对泰国炎热潮湿的气候环境进行优化，可以帮助用户在一次涂抹中完成多个护肤和彩妆步骤，节省早晨化妆时间。该产品体现了泰国美妆市场对于多功能、便携式护肤创新的需求。

title: Bargain hunters pounce as market stalls
desc: The property downturn is no longer producing the same outcome for everyone. While residential developers pull back amid weak demand and mounting financial pressure, brokers and private equity investors are stepping forward, seeing one of the strongest buying opportunities in years.
title_cn: 房产下行期投资者择机抄底
summary_cn: 泰国房产市场进入下行周期，开发商因需求疲软、财务压力增加而纷纷收缩业务。但与此同时，房产经纪人和私募基金投资者却敏锐地发现了这一时期蕴含的商机，认为当前是多年来最佳的投资窗口。这些专业投资者正加速入场布局，准备在市场底部进行战略性投资。业内分析认为，泰国房产市场有望迎来新一轮的调整与机遇。
desc_original: The property downturn is no longer producing the same outcome for everyone. While residential developers pull back amid weak demand and mounting financial pressure, brokers and private equity investors are stepping forward, seeing one of the strongest buying opportunities in years.

title: Launching a bid  for AI sovereignty
desc: Thailand is advancing artificial intelligence (AI) sovereignty through domestic large language models (LLM) such as ThaiLLM, led by the Big Data Institute (BDI) and its partners.
title_cn: 泰国推进AI主权战略：ThaiLLM项目揭幕
summary_cn: 泰国正通过大数据研究所(BDI)及合作伙伴推进AI主权建设，开发本土大语言模型ThaiLLM。这一举措旨在减少对国外AI技术依赖，提升国家AI能力。随着全球AI竞争加剧，泰国此举意义重大，有望在东南亚AI领域占据重要位置。
desc_original: Thailand is advancing artificial intelligence (AI) sovereignty through domestic large language models (LLM) such as ThaiLLM, led by the Big Data Institute (BDI) and its partners.

title: Data centre race faces power logjam
desc: Power, not land prices, has become the biggest hurdle for data centre investors evaluating Thailand, as growing demand is increasingly constrained by limited electricity and water infrastructure, according to property consultancy Savills Thailand.
title_cn: 数据中心扩张遇瓶颈：电力短缺成泰国最大障碍
summary_cn: 泰国数据中心市场需求旺盛，但电力供应已成投资者面临的最大挑战。根据房产顾问公司Savills Thailand分析，电力匮乏比地价上升更为突出。随着数据中心需求激增，泰国有限的电力和水资源基础设施难以满足扩张需求，解决能源瓶颈已成产业发展的关键。
desc_original: Power, not land prices, has become the biggest hurdle for data centre investors evaluating Thailand, as growing demand is increasingly constrained by limited electricity and water infrastructure, according to property consultancy Savills Thailand.

title: Thailand to avoid Mideast war oil shock
desc: Thailand will not face a crude oil shortage in August despite the ongoing war in the Middle East, as supply remains sufficient for all six domestic refineries, according to the Department of Energy Business (DOEB).
title_cn: 中东冲突无碍供应：泰国原油充足无虞
summary_cn: 尽管中东局势紧张，泰国能源业务部(DOEB)确保该国不会在8月面临原油短缺。泰国拥有6个国内炼油厂，现有供应足以满足全部炼油需求。这表明泰国能源供应链韧性强，地缘政治风险暂未对能源市场造成实质冲击，物价稳定性有保障。
desc_original: Thailand will not face a crude oil shortage in August despite the ongoing war in the Middle East, as supply remains sufficient for all six domestic refineries, according to the Department of Energy Business (DOEB).

title: Trade deficit marks a sea change
desc: Thailand's widening trade deficit may appear alarming at first glance, but a deeper analysis suggests it is more a sign of economic transformation than deterioration.
title_cn: 贸易赤字扩大背后：经济转型信号而非衰退警讯
summary_cn: 泰国贸易赤字持续扩大，乍看令人担忧。但深入分析表明，赤字扩大更多反映的是经济结构调整而非衰退迹象。这种变化标志着泰国经济正经历转型期，进出口格局变化反映了产业升级和消费结构优化。需要辩证解读而非片面悲观。
desc_original: Thailand's widening trade deficit may appear alarming at first glance, but a deeper analysis suggests it is more a sign of economic transformation than deterioration.

title: Exat drafts payout criteria for bridge in Koh Chang
desc: TRAT: The Expressway Authority of Thailand (Exat) has outlined compensation criteria for landowners affected by the proposed Koh Chang bridge as residents raised concerns that payments may not be sufficient to help them relocate, despite broad support for the project.
title_cn: 象岛跨海大桥补偿方案启动：泰国高速公路局发布赔偿标准
summary_cn: 泰国高速公路管理局(Exat)公布了象岛(Koh Chang)跨海大桥项目的地主补偿标准。该大桥项目位于达叻府(Trat Province)，得到广泛支持，但受影响地主担忧补偿金额不足以支持迁居。Exat已制定详细补偿方案，力求平衡发展需求与住户权益。
desc_original: TRAT: The Expressway Authority of Thailand (Exat) has outlined compensation criteria for landowners affected by the proposed Koh Chang bridge as residents raised concerns that payments may not be sufficient to help them relocate, despite broad support for the project.

title: Questions swirl over BJT unity
desc: Although Bhumjaithai (BJT) leaders insist the party remains united, a series of recent developments has fuelled speculation over whether Thailand's dominant coalition partner is facing more than routine political tensions.
title_cn: 人民力量党（Bhumjaithai）统一性受质疑
summary_cn: 人民力量党（Bhumjaithai）是泰国现任政府的主要联盟伙伴。尽管党领导层坚称党内仍保持团结，但最近一系列事态发展引发外界猜测，该党是否正面临超出常规的政治紧张局势，可能对政府稳定性产生影响。
desc_original: Although Bhumjaithai (BJT) leaders insist the party remains united, a series of recent developments has fuelled speculation over whether Thailand's dominant coalition partner is facing more than routine political tensions.

title: Dugong's death 'unclear'
desc: Phuket: Marine scientists were unable to determine the exact cause of death of a juvenile male dugong found washed ashore in Phang Nga's Takua Thung district on Friday, as the carcass was in an advanced state of decomposition.
title_cn: 普吉发现死亡海牛，死因成谜
summary_cn: 泰国普吉地区攀牙府土亚通县（Takua Thung）海岸周五发现一只年幼雄性海牛尸体冲上岸。海洋科学家因尸体腐烂程度严重，无法确定其确切死因。海牛是东南亚濒危物种，其不明死亡引发对海洋生态保护的关注。
desc_original: Phuket: Marine scientists were unable to determine the exact cause of death of a juvenile male dugong found washed ashore in Phang Nga's Takua Thung district on Friday, as the carcass was in an advanced state of decomposition.

title: Police under fire over missing case updates
desc: Police in Chon Buri have apologised to the families of three Thai murder victims for failing to provide regular updates on the investigation, while insisting officers continued working on the case and remain committed to bringing those responsible to justice.
title_cn: 春武里警方因案情通报不力致歉
summary_cn: 泰国春武里府警方因未能向三名谋杀案遇害者家属定期通报调查进展而向其致歉。尽管警方坚称官员仍在继续调查此案，并承诺将把责任人绳之以法，但案情沟通不力已引发受害人家属的不满与质疑。
desc_original: Police in Chon Buri have apologised to the families of three Thai murder victims for failing to provide regular updates on the investigation, while insisting officers continued working on the case and remain committed to bringing those responsible to justice.

title: Govt reviews power deals
desc: The government is reviewing long-term power purchase agreements (PPAs) with private producers as part of efforts to lower electricity prices, Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt said on Sunday.
title_cn: 政府重审电力采购协议，力图降低电价
summary_cn: 泰国副总理帕空·尼拉巴（Pakorn Nilprapunt）表示，政府正在审查与民营发电商签订的长期电力采购协议（PPA），以此作为降低电价的努力之一。此举意在缓解民众和企业的电费负担，改善生活成本。
desc_original: The government is reviewing long-term power purchase agreements (PPAs) with private producers as part of efforts to lower electricity prices, Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt said on Sunday.

title: Lao bank seeks police inquiry
desc: Officials from Laos, including Lao Development Bank, have asked the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) to investigate false allegations on social media linking the bank to money laundering.
title_cn: 老挝官方要求泰警调查银行诽谤指控
summary_cn: 老挝官员（包括老挝开发银行）已要求泰国中央调查局（CIB）调查社交媒体上将该银行与洗钱活动挂钩的不实指控。虚假指控影响银行国际声誉，招致老挝官方要求通过法律途径澄清，涉及国际金融诚信问题。
desc_original: Officials from Laos, including Lao Development Bank, have asked the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) to investigate false allegations on social media linking the bank to money laundering.

title: Twenty provinces warned of flash floods
desc: The Office of the National Water Resources (ONWR) has warned 20 provinces to prepare for possible flash floods, forest runoff, landslides and river overflows from Aug 2-4 as heavy rain is forecast in several regions.
title_cn: 二十个省份收到山洪预警
summary_cn: 泰国国家水资源办公室警告20个省份在8月2至4日期间做好防范准备，预计将出现山洪、林地径流、山体滑坡和河水溢出等灾害，原因是多个地区预报将出现强降雨。
desc_original: The Office of the National Water Resources (ONWR) has warned 20 provinces to prepare for possible flash floods, forest runoff, landslides and river overflows from Aug 2-4 as heavy rain is forecast in several regions.

title: Chevron completes Total Wellhead Platform Reuse at Chaba B
desc: Chevron Offshore (Thailand) Ltd has safely and successfully completed its first Total Wellhead Platform Reuse project in the Gulf of Thailand, reflecting the company’s focus on practical innovation that improves efficiency, lowers costs and supports efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
title_cn: 雪佛龙完成泰国湾查巴B油田平台重用项目
summary_cn: 雪佛龙泰国海洋公司（Chevron Offshore Thailand Ltd）成功完成泰国湾首个总平台重用项目。该创新举措提升作业效率、降低成本，同时支持温室气体减排目标，体现公司推进可持续发展的承诺。
desc_original: Chevron Offshore (Thailand) Ltd has safely and successfully completed its first Total Wellhead Platform Reuse project in the Gulf of Thailand, reflecting the company’s focus on practical innovation that improves efficiency, lowers costs and supports efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

title: แยกขังเดี่ยวแก๊งฆ่าฝังดิน จ.ชลบุรี "ธง-บอล" เครียด ส่วน "ป๋อง" มีอาการเรียบเฉย
desc: แยกขังเดี่ยวแก๊งฆ่าฝังดิน จ.ชลบุรี รอดูอาการและกักกันโรค เตรียมหาแดนคุมขังที่เหมาะสม ป้องกันถูกรุมประชาทัณฑ์ เผย "ธง-บอล" เครียด ส่วน "ป๋อง" มีอาการเรียบเฉย
title_cn: 春武里杀人埋尸案嫌疑人被隔离单独监禁
summary_cn: 春武里省涉嫌杀人埋尸的案件嫌疑人被转至单独监禁，当局观察其身体状况和防疫隔离，并计划安排合适的监禁地点以防止狱中暴力事件。其中部分嫌疑人表现出紧张情绪，另一部分则态度镇定。

title: Chinese man beats wife to death over alleged affair in Chiang Mai
desc: Chinese man beats wife to death over alleged affair in Chiang Mai Legacy A Chinese man was arrested today, August 2, after allegedly beating his wife to death at their rented home in Chiang Mai following an argument over claims she was having an affair . Police were called to the home in a housing estate in Chang Phueak, Mueang district, at around 12.10am. Rescue workers found the 38 year old Chinese woman unconscious in an upstairs bedroom and attempted CPR, but she was pronounced dead at the scene. According to police, the suspect and his wife had moved into the house about a month ago so they could care for their child, who is studying at an international school in Thailand. Investigators said the 45 year old husband told them he had received a phone call from a friend in China claiming his wife was having an affair . The phone call reportedly led to an argument that escalated into the fatal assault. DailyNews reported that the couple’s child witnessed the incident. Photo via Amarin TV The husband was taken into custody and charged with assault causing death. title: Thailand plans UNESCO nomination for Death Railway
desc: Thailand plans UNESCO nomination for Death Railway Legacy Thailand is preparing to nominate part of the historic Death Railway in Kanchanaburi for UNESCO World Heritage status , with the Ministry of Culture and the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation supporting the proposal. The nomination follows the conclusion of the 48th World Heritage Committee meeting in South Korea, where UNESCO considered 30 new World Heritage nominations and reviewed the conservation status of 147 existing sites. Officials said the proposal highlights both the railway’s historical significance during World War II and its connection to protected natural areas in western Thailand. The route passes through Sai Yok National Park, Thong Pha Phum National Park and the Sangkhlaburi area. Officials said World Heritage status could strengthen conservation efforts across the surrounding landscape. Photo via Pakpraek Town Municipality Department of National Parks director-general Attapol Charoenchansa said Kanchanaburi is one of Thailand’s most important World War II heritage sites and that the nomination could also help promote tourism in the country’s western region. summary_cn: 泰国文化部和国家公园部门联合支持将坎昌武里历史死亡铁路（Death Railway）申报为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。该铁路承载二战时期的重要历史价值，沿线经过赛耀国家公园（Sai Yok）、通帕峰国家公园等多个保护区。世界遗产身份将加强该地区的文化保护力度，促进西部地区旅游发展。

title: 泰国警方捣毁一非洲“假钞变美钞”诈骗团伙
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月2日，泰国曼谷京畿警察署透露，在近日展开的“局中局”卧底行动中，两名利比里亚籍诈骗犯误将曼谷京畿警察署禁毒小队的卧底警察选为诈骗目标，让流传了30年之久的全球经典骗局“神奇药水制造美钞”被彻底揭穿。嫌疑人当场演练了所有诈骗步骤，且声称可制作价值达600万美元（折合约2亿泰铢）的“假钞”。 曼谷京畿警察署副署长提拉德警少将表示，禁毒小组一直在深入侦办涉非洲跨国毒品犯罪网络，今年7月26日，调查人员在Soi Nana一带追踪该网络的重要犯罪嫌疑人时，一路跟踪到曼谷的一场豪车聚会活动。卧底警察当即伪装成对豪车感兴趣的富豪，引起了该团伙的注意。 嫌疑人主动提出，可以为卧底警察筹集资金购买豪车，并极力吹嘘他财力雄厚，且资金来自黑市业务，手头有600万美元（折合约2亿泰铢）现金，但因税务查验被暂扣。随后，嫌疑人拉拢卧底警察出资15万泰铢现金作为“打点费”，并承诺拿到后，可通过特殊工序将白纸还原为等额的真实美钞，同时承诺给予40%的分成。嫌疑人完全不知道和他交涉的是卧底警察，还和卧底警察约时间，准备现场演示将白纸变成真实美钞。 8月1日，提拉德警少将带领执法人员部署“局中局”行动，对上述诈骗团伙实施抓捕，力求人赃俱获。到了约定时间，2名嫌疑人到达现场，掏出事先经化学试剂（淀粉/碘酒）处理成白色/黑色遮罩的美钞白纸，现场将液体涂抹在上面，使原本100面额的美钞显露出来，并称该液体是特殊的化学药水。但实际上，该液体仅为溶解在水里的维生素C，用来洗去表面的遮罩，从而露出藏在内部的真钞。 两名嫌疑人施展诈骗把戏的全程被警方多角度监控，在这场闹剧结束后，卧底警察当即表明身份，埋伏在四周的执法人员迅速上前将其抓获。警方以“共同组织或参与非法秘密结社及非法入境”的罪名对二人实施逮捕，同时查扣了大量美钞和诈骗工具，并将嫌疑人及随身物品移交给Makkasan警察局依法提起诉讼。 在搜查中，警方还发现了大量用于伪造美钞的证物，于是组织警力对涉案的可疑场所进行了彻查。在第一名嫌疑人位于La Salle路的住所内，警方查获了6万张美钞大小的白纸，推测是用来印制约600万美元假钞的工具；在第二名嫌疑人位于Hua Mak的住所内，查获了假钞和多项证据。此外，警方还在室内发现了另2名喀麦隆籍非法入境人员，遂以“非法入境”罪将其逮捕，并移交给Hua Mak警察局依法处理。 提拉德警少将指出，嫌疑人使用的诈骗手段属于典型的“假钞骗局”或“黑/白纸钞骗局”，其利用基础化学原理加上“魔术骗局”（利用碘与淀粉的化学反应，洗去外层涂抹的颜料）制造幻象，让受害者误以为白纸真的能变成真钱。这种诈骗手段自20世纪90年代起就在全球流行，遍及欧洲、美国和东南亚，一旦受害者信以为真，嫌疑人就会给出一大沓白纸（普通白纸，非经过处理的真钞）和假药水，之后便卷款潜逃。虽然大多数民众对这类骗局略有所闻，但鲜有
title_cn: 泰国警方瓦解非洲诈骗团伙「假钞变美钞」骗局

title: Phuket woman charged after beheading mother-in-law
desc: Phuket woman charged after beheading mother-in-law Legacy A woman was arrested after allegedly beheading her mother-in-law with a kitchen knife following an argument at their home in Phuket yesterday, August 1. Police were called to the property in Chalong, Mueang district, at around 9.25am after neighbours reported the killing. The victim, 74 year old Chantra, was found dead inside the house . title: 泰国出台新法规，调整工程承包商“弃工”判定条件
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月2日，泰国总理府办公室副发言人普洛塔莱透露，政府公报网站发布了2026版《关于弃工行为认定的部级法规》，其中明确规定，建筑工程承包方在履约或怠于履约的过程中，若对公众的生命、身体或财产造成严重损害，将直接被认定为“弃工”。该部级法规由副总理兼财政部部长艾尼提于2026年7月23日签署，并于7月27日公布生效。 另外，政府公报网站的公告还附注了出台该部级法规的原因：根据2017版《政府采购管理法》第109条第6款的规定，部级法规可对“弃工”的认定标准进行规定，所以有必要制定本部级法规，明确将施工承包商严重危及公众生命、身体或财产的行为，清晰界定为“弃工”。 《关于弃工行为认定的部级法规》将有助于政府部门在发生重大施工事故后，立即终止合同并将涉事承包商列入黑名单。同时，该部级法规将与“承包商记分系统”同步配套使用，后者可通过扣分来暂停承包商参与新项目投标的资格，从而使政府拥有更具决定性的法律工具来惩处私营企业，保障人民群众的安全。 （编译：KA；来源：thebangkokinsight） The post 泰国出台新法规，调整工程承包商“弃工”判定条件 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Philippine Airlines denies reports homeless Bangkok man is former captain
desc: Philippine Airlines denies reports homeless Bangkok man is former captain Legacy Philippine Airlines (PAL) , on July 31, denied reports that a homeless man found injured in Bangkok is one of its pilots, saying that the captain identified in the stories remains on active duty . The airline issued a statement after Thai media and social media posts claimed the man, who was found beneath the BTS Phloen Chit station, was a former PAL pilot who had fallen on hard times. Photo via Facebook/ กั๊ก บายอัส โมเดลลิ่ง “The information is false. Captain Larry Malpaya remains an active pilot with PAL and is not the individual referred to or shown in the reports,” the airline said. Philippines News Agency reported that PAL had asked Thai PBS World to immediately correct its report and related social media posts to prevent the misinformation from spreading further. The man was later taken to hospital by the Mirror Foundation , a Thai non-governmental organisation working on a range of social issues. In a Facebook post on July 31, the organisation said it coordinated with police to have him admitted after observing that he required urgent medical treatment and further assistance . Photo

title: Chiang Rai raid seizes eight million meth pills
desc: Chiang Rai raid seizes eight million meth pills Legacy Narcotics Suppression Police Region 3 , working alongside the Pha Muang Task Force and Ranger Regiment 31, seized eight million methamphetamine pills hidden inside a cemetery in Chiang Rai ‘s Thoeng district . The pills, discovered yesterday, August 1, are believed to be part of a cross-border trafficking network with a financier hiding in Laos. Officers recovered 27 sacks of the drugs from Ban Sao Wa cemetery in Moo 3, San Sai Ngam subdistrict. The stash had been concealed among the gravesites while traffickers waited for an opportunity to move it further into the country. The raid followed weeks of intelligence gathering by the joint task force, which tracked the shipment’s journey from its point of origin to the storage site. Investigators say the pills were produced at a pressing factory in Ban Poo Na Ko, Shan State, in Myanmar, using precursor chemicals sourced from the nearby town of Mueang Tum. The batch was first moved to Mong Phaeng before being smuggled across the Mekong River into Ton Pheung and Ban Huay Sai in Bokeo province, Laos. From there, the network exploited the forested border terrain around Wian
title_cn: 清莱警方查获800万粒冰毒走私大案
summary_cn: 清莱府缉毒警察在缉毒小组及护卫队第31团配合下，于8月1日在Thoeng县墓地内查获800万粒甲基苯丙胺（冰毒）。毒品藏匿墓地中等待贩毒集团转运，源自缅甸掸邦的走私网络。该批毒品由生产地运往老挝磨乃、坤岭等地，经由老挝中间商（财务负责人躲藏老挝）协调，通过湄公河走私入泰国境内。案件涉及跨国贩毒网络的复杂路线及多环节协作。

title: Pattaya court denies bail for Russian siblings’ murder suspects
desc: Pattaya court denies bail for Russian siblings’ murder suspects Legacy A Pattaya provincial court has denied bail to suspects held over two separate murder cases in Huai Yai , ruling that the seriousness of the charges, the severity of potential penalties, and the risk of flight made release too dangerous. The first case centres on the deaths of two Russian siblings, who vanished along with their Honda ADV 150 motorcycle before Huai Yai Police Station investigators uncovered evidence linking the disappearance to a killing. Police allege the pair were murdered and their bodies buried. Investigators brought 43 year old Thanatip “Pong” Kerdthong and 39 year old Thongchai Srinil before Pattaya Provincial Court on August 1 for their first detention hearing. Police requested an initial 12-day detention period, running August 1 to 12, to continue gathering evidence. Thanatip and Thongchai face a raft of charges, including jointly committing premeditated murder, committing an offence to obtain benefits or conceal another crime , nighttime robbery, impersonating police officers while armed, and illegal possession of firearms and ammunition. The court denied their release,

title: GMM“娃团”爆火，年利润破120万
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月2日，泰国GMMTV的吉祥物营销策略正在证明，“可爱”真的能带来实实在在的收入。专门为GMMTV负责吉祥物运营的Gemmistry Soul有限公司，年利润从2024年的265,188泰铢暴涨至2025年的1,254,126泰铢，几乎翻了5倍，充分说明吉祥物已经不只是可爱的赠品，而是公司认真在经营的业务。 让粉丝们彻底沦陷的关键是，明星们亲自参与了吉祥物的“DNA”设计，包括角色、性格和特有的气质，每个吉祥物都像有了生命，有声音、有自我，如同明星的“孩子”一样，粉丝们都想陪伴着它们长大。现在，不少吉祥物已经有了自己的独立粉丝群，不仅是“爸爸/妈妈”（明星）有粉丝，“孩子”（吉祥物）也有粉丝。有的吉祥物甚至可以单独出席活动，不需要明星爸爸妈妈跟着去，就像孩子长大到能自己出门玩了。如果明星爸爸妈妈和吉祥物一家集体出动，粉丝们就更开心了。 GMMTV让人喜爱的吉祥物目前已有32个，包括Polcasan、Any、Lunar、Permpoon等等。粉丝们追着买周边商品，钱包都快掏空了，从公仔、钥匙扣到可爱睡衣，应有尽有。吉祥物不再只是纪念品，而是明星和粉丝家庭里的新成员，既能治愈人心，也能给公司带来丰厚的收入。 （编译：KA；来源：workpointtoday） The post GMM“娃团”爆火，年利润破120万 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 时隔15年，泰总理明日出访印尼
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月2日，泰国总理府办公室发言人拉差妲透露，总理兼内政部部长阿努廷定于8月3日至4日对印度尼西亚进行正式访问，并与印尼总统普拉博沃举行会谈。这是泰国总理15年来首次正式出访印尼，旨在推行主动外交政策，通过领导人层面的交往打开经济合作的大门，将泰国-印尼的战略伙伴关系转化为切实可行的合作项目，涵盖贸易、投资、旅游、安全、粮食安全、能源、教育以及工商界等多个领域。 拉差妲指出，印尼是东盟最大的经济体，拥有2.8亿人口，同时也是一个庞大的市场和重要的投资来源地，是泰国企业的潜在合作伙伴。深化两国关系有助于推动更多泰国商品和服务进入印尼市场、强化供应链连接、促进双向投资，并为泰国的大型企业及中小企业创造新机遇。 政府致力于让外事访问带来惠及本国民众的成果，包括扩大农产品和食品市场、增加游客数量、创造就业岗位、提升劳动力技能，以及在双方具备优势的领域开展知识与技术交流。这次访问不仅巩固了领导人之间的友谊，还把良好的关系转化为具体的贸易、投资和增收机遇，政府希望借外交振兴经济，切实提升人民的生活质量。 泰国和印尼同为东盟创始成员国，在区域发展中发挥着关键的作用，两国领导人将通过这次会晤，促进东盟的团结与强韧，共同应对全球经济、跨国犯罪和地缘政治的变化。双方将就经济、安全、区域互联互通、粮食、能源和可持续发展等领域的合作深入交换意见，一起打造有利的营商环境，确保东盟始终充满和平、稳定与经济机遇，造福各国人民。 拉差妲补充说，这次出访印尼是向东盟表达泰国外交愿景的重要平台，展示出泰国共同塑造区域未来的决心，为2028年接任东盟轮值主席国做好准备，泰国将聚焦于构建一个团结、具备经济韧性、以人为本且实现平衡可持续发展的东盟。另外，此行还体现出泰国政府超越礼仪性访问的远瞻性视角，在全球充满竞争和不确定性的大背景下，建立战略伙伴关系，维持国际关系平衡，并提升泰国的经济议价能力。 本次访问的日程安排如下： -8月3日，阿努廷及其代表团从第二军用机场启程，飞抵雅加达哈利姆机场。随后前往印尼总统府，出席官方欢迎仪式、领导人小范围会谈、大范围会谈以及共同会见记者。 -8月4日，阿努廷将出席由印度尼西亚工商会（KADIN）与印尼泰国商会联合举办的商业论坛开幕式，以对接两国企业并推动双向投资机遇。之后，阿努廷将前往东盟秘书处，与东盟秘书长就促进区域合作进行会谈，并发表有关东盟未来愿景的演讲。在与印尼私营部门讨论拓展商业合作的机会后，阿努廷一行将于当晚结束行程，返回泰国。 （编译：KA；来源：ch3plus） The post 时隔15年，泰总理明日出访印尼 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国严管网购，售后问题平台商家一起担责
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月1日，泰国总理府办公室部长兼消费者保护委员会办公室负责人素帕玛透露，她已指派总理府办公室部长顾问普拉登猜作为代表，推动网络购物平台管理的相关政策，切实保护消费者权利。此前，消费者保护委员会办公室已于7月31日在泰国商会大学与合作网络召开研讨会，就综合解决网购消费者保护的问题进行了讨论，以制定国家层面的行动计划。 素帕玛表示，现在网购的问题不少，比如不合格商品、不安全商品，或者货不对版等，但消费者购物后的问题却经常得不到保障，这是政府必须尽快调整的重要议题。网络购物平台的消费者保护不能只盯着卖家，而是要看整个网络交易链条，尤其是提供服务的数字平台，它们是连接卖家和消费者的中间方，也从交易中获利。 虽然目前消费者保护委员会办公室在法律上还没有直接关闭或暂停网络平台服务的权力，但政策方面认为，政府不该止步于这些限制，而是应基于“共同责任”原则，让卖家和网络平台一起承担责任。接下来，消保委将对相关法律和监管机制进行研究，让平台负起责任，一起预防、制止、帮助非法商品造成的损失，并对违规店铺采取更有效的管理措施。 素帕玛强调，这次推动网购平台管理是阿努廷政府政策的延续，希望数字经济在增长的同时，能够保护好民众的权利。她已要求消保委与负责数字、网络贸易和直销业务的部门商量，制定合作机制，明确主要部门和支持部门的角色，并设定清晰的指标，让网购消费者保护在全国真正落地。 除此之外，消保委正在研究集体诉讼的可行性，以便在大量消费者遭受同类损害时，能够更容易地进入司法程序，减轻小额受害者的负担。网络购物平台管理政策的主要目标不是给企业增加负担，而是在促进数字经济和保护消费者权利之间取得平衡，让民众能放心网购，诚实经营的商家也能在透明、公平的市场中获得信任。 （编译：KA；来源：matichon） The post 泰国严管网购，售后问题平台商家一起担责 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国升级安全措施，全力保障游客安全
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月1日，泰国旅游与体育部部长素拉萨向春武里府俄籍兄妹遇害案的家属表达了最深切的哀悼和歉意，他表示，在总理兼内政部部长阿努廷的领导下，泰国政府密切关注相关情况，并要求各部门迅速、透明地侦查该案，为受害者讨回公道，恢复国家形象和信心。 旅游与体育部已与俄罗斯驻泰国大使馆、国家警察总署、旅游警察和当地部门协调，全力照顾并协助遇难者家属。同时，他已下令提高全国旅游区的安全措施，包括增加风险地点的巡逻人员、整合安全信息、使用监控摄像头，以及让游客援助中心（TAC）保持24小时待命。 素拉萨强调，虽然这是个别刑事案件，但政府会根据事实改进安全措施，并严厉处罚违法者，绝不姑息。政府致力于让全世界的游客放心，泰国始终将每一位来访者的权利和福祉放在最高位置。 （编译：KA；来源：thairath） The post 泰国升级安全措施，全力保障游客安全 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: PM vows irrigation for farmers
desc: Irrigation development will speed up nationwide to help increase farmers' incomes and reduce the impact of recurring floods and droughts, says Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.
title_cn: 总理誓言加快全国灌溉工程
summary_cn: 总理兼内政部长阿努廷·川维拉昆宣布，政府将加速全国灌溉工程建设，帮助农民增加收入，减少周期性洪涝和干旱灾害对农业的影响。这是政府支持农业现代化、保护农民利益的重要举措。
desc_original: Irrigation development will speed up nationwide to help increase farmers' incomes and reduce the impact of recurring floods and droughts, says Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

desc: The annual Thailand International Choral Festival is set to take place from Monday until Friday at the Thailand Cultural Centre in Bangkok, with performances from 21 Thai and international choirs under this year's theme of "Sabai Sabai".
title_cn: 2026泰国国际合唱节汇聚21支合唱团
summary_cn: 泰国国际合唱节（Thai ICF）2026年大会将在曼谷泰国文化中心举办，为期五天。本届汇集来自泰国及国际的21支合唱团参与演出，以「悠闲自在」（Sabai Sabai）为主题，为音乐爱好者呈现精彩的合唱表演。
desc_original: The annual Thailand International Choral Festival is set to take place from Monday until Friday at the Thailand Cultural Centre in Bangkok, with performances from 21 Thai and international choirs under this year's theme of "Sabai Sabai".

title: Thailand Riviera coastal drive gets tourism push
desc: Regional authorities are stepping up efforts to promote the Thailand Riviera coastal route as a major tourism corridor, as part of plans to improve public awareness, enhance visitor facilities and spread tourism income to communities along the Gulf of Thailand's western coastline.
title_cn: 泰国里维埃拉沿海走廊成旅游推广重点
summary_cn: 地方旅游部门加大力度推广泰国里维埃拉（Thailand Riviera）沿海走廊，计划打造其为主要旅游目的地。相关工作涉及提升公众认知度、改善游客设施和基础建设、扩大泰国湾西岸沿线社区的旅游收入分配，促进地方经济发展。
desc_original: Regional authorities are stepping up efforts to promote the Thailand Riviera coastal route as a major tourism corridor, as part of plans to improve public awareness, enhance visitor facilities and spread tourism income to communities along the Gulf of Thailand's western coastline.

title: Lumpini Park puts smart parking to test
desc: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) will begin testing a new smart parking management system at Lumpini Park in September as part of efforts to ease chronic parking congestion and improve convenience and safety for park visitors.
title_cn: 勒末尼公园试点智能停车管理系统
summary_cn: 曼谷市政府计划于9月在勒末尼公园（Lumpini Park）启动新型智能停车管理系统试点。该系统旨在缓解公园长期停车难问题，提升游客便利度和安全性，为后续全市推广积累经验。
desc_original: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) will begin testing a new smart parking management system at Lumpini Park in September as part of efforts to ease chronic parking congestion and improve convenience and safety for park visitors.

title: Cabinet backs faster removal of foreigners
desc: A cabinet-backed draft regulation will allow authorities to remove foreigners whose conduct is deemed incompatible with Thai morals and social norms, Deputy Prime Minister for Legal Affairs Pakorn Nilprapunt said.
title_cn: 内阁支持加快驱逐行为不当的外国人
summary_cn: 泰国政府通过新规草案，授权当局将行为被认为与泰国道德和社会规范不符的外国人驱逐出境。法律事务副总理帕昆·尼帕布恩特（Pakorn Nilprapunt）表示，此举旨在维护国家的道德秩序和社会安定。
desc_original: A cabinet-backed draft regulation will allow authorities to remove foreigners whose conduct is deemed incompatible with Thai morals and social norms, Deputy Prime Minister for Legal Affairs Pakorn Nilprapunt said.

title: Appetite grows for Talay Noi swamp buffalo meat
desc: PHATTHALUNG: A research-driven initiative to develop premium meat products from naturally raised swamp buffalo in the Talay Noi wetlands is gaining traction, with demand growing locally and from China.
title_cn: 达莱泰莱湿地沼泽野牛肉销售增长
summary_cn: 位于披集县（Phatthalung）泰莱湿地（Talay Noi）的研究团队推出高端沼泽野牛肉产品，选用自然饲养的野牛为原料。该特色产品在本地和中国市场需求旺盛，产业前景看好。
desc_original: PHATTHALUNG: A research-driven initiative to develop premium meat products from naturally raised swamp buffalo in the Talay Noi wetlands is gaining traction, with demand growing locally and from China.

title: Sadao crossing upgrades to drive growth
desc: SONGKHLA: The Sadao Border Checkpoint is again set to handle more than six million travellers this year as authorities seek to expand cross-border trade and improve links with Malaysia, visiting senators said.
title_cn: 沙敦边界关卡升级促进增长
summary_cn: 宋卡府（Songkhla）沙敦边界关卡（Sadao）今年预计通行逾 600 万人次。泰国参议员表示，当局将升级该关卡设施，旨在扩大跨境贸易规模并加强与马来西亚的联系。
desc_original: SONGKHLA: The Sadao Border Checkpoint is again set to handle more than six million travellers this year as authorities seek to expand cross-border trade and improve links with Malaysia, visiting senators said.

title: Public Health Ministry launches nursing volunteer scheme
desc: The Public Health Ministry has launched a new community nursing volunteer programme aimed at strengthening primary healthcare services.
title_cn: 卫生部推出社区护理志愿者计划
summary_cn: 泰国公共卫生部启动新型社区护理志愿者计划，旨在强化基层医疗卫生服务体系。该项目通过组织志愿护士深入社区，提升民众的医疗卫生水平。
desc_original: The Public Health Ministry has launched a new community nursing volunteer programme aimed at strengthening primary healthcare services.

title: 'Kathu model' a lifesaver for ex-users
desc: A community-based drug rehabilitation programme in Phuket is helping former drug users rebuild their lives through sustained treatment, family support and employment.
title_cn: 「卡都模式」为戒毒者点亮新生之光
summary_cn: 普吉岛（Phuket）卡都区（Kathu）推行社区型毒品康复计划，通过持续治疗、家庭支持和职业培训，帮助前成瘾者重建生活。该模式已显示出良好的社会效果和康复成果。
desc_original: A community-based drug rehabilitation programme in Phuket is helping former drug users rebuild their lives through sustained treatment, family support and employment.

title: Super El Niño to arrive in Thailand next year
desc: Thailand is unlikely to escape the impact of a Super El Niño expected to hit the country in October and last through the early part of the 2027 rainy season, affecting crops, rice plantations and water consumption.
title_cn: 超强厄尔尼诺现象（El Niño）将袭泰国
summary_cn: 泰国预计今年10月将迎来超强厄尔尼诺现象的冲击，该气候事件将持续至2027年雨季初期。超强厄尔尼诺将对泰国农业造成严重影响，包括农作物减产、水稻种植困难和水资源消耗增加，可能引发食品供应压力。
desc_original: Thailand is unlikely to escape the impact of a Super El Niño expected to hit the country in October and last through the early part of the 2027 rainy season, affecting crops, rice plantations and water consumption.

title: Anutin vows justice over murders
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has expressed condolences to the family of two Russian siblings killed in a high-profile murder case and apologised to Russian tourists and the Russian people over the incident.
title_cn: 总理承诺为俄罗斯公民谋杀案伸张正义
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·昭瓦利拉库尔（Anutin Charnvirakul）就两名俄罗斯兄妹遇害案件向遇害者家属表示慰问，并向俄国游客和俄罗斯政府正式道歉。总理承诺将全力追查此案，伸张正义，以维护泰国国际声誉。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has expressed condolences to the family of two Russian siblings killed in a high-profile murder case and apologised to Russian tourists and the Russian people over the incident.

title: ตำรวจปิดล้อมยิงปะทะสนั่นคู้บอน 27 ล่าตัว "ซัน" มือปืนบุกรัวยิงหนุ่มดับกลางงานศพ
desc: เจ้าหน้าที่ตำรวจ ปิดล้อมยิงปะทะสนั่นคู้บอน 27 ล่าตัว "ซัน" มือปืนอุกอาจ บุกรัวยิงหนุ่มดับต่อหน้าศพแฟนสาวกลางวัดบึงทองหลาง
title_cn: 警方围剿悍匪库库邦街激战，葬礼枪战再起
summary_cn: 警方在库库邦街27号与通缉犯、武装枪手「ซัน」进行激烈交火。该逃犯随后闯入翁通杭寺（Wat Bung Thonglang）葬礼现场，向一名年轻男子开枪射击，导致其死亡。事件中另有两人受伤。此案反映泰国部分地区治安隐患。
desc_original: เจ้าหน้าที่ตำรวจ ปิดล้อมยิงปะทะสนั่นคู้บอน 27 ล่าตัว "ซัน" มือปืนอุกอาจ บุกรัวยิงหนุ่มดับต่อหน้าศพแฟนสาวกลางวัดบึงทองหลาง

title: ราชทัณฑ์ แจงปมปล่อยตัว “ป๋อง-ธง” ยันทำตาม พ.ร.บ.ป้องกันการกระทำผิดซ้ำฯ
desc: กรมราชทัณฑ์ แจงกรณี “ป๋อง-ธง” อดีตผู้ต้องขังก่อเหตุฆ่าฝังดิน 5 ศพ ยืนยันปฏิบัติหน้าที่ตาม พ.ร.บ.มาตรการป้องกันการกระทำผิดซ้ำฯ (JSOC) ครบทุกขั้นตอน ก่อนปล่อยตัว
title_cn: 监狱部为释放埋尸罪犯「庞-挺」进行声明
summary_cn: 泰国皇家监狱部（Royal Thai Correctional Department）就曾因埋尸五具案入狱的重刑犯「庞-挺」（Pong-Teng）被释放一事进行官方声明。监狱部强调在其获释前已严格遵循《防止犯罪再犯措施法》（JSOC）的所有规定和审查程序，旨在回应公众关于重刑犯释放的质疑。

desc: เพื่อนรุ่นพี่แค้น คนตายทำปืนลั่นใส่ภรรยา ได้ประกันตัวมารดน้ำศพ ก่อนถูกรัวยิงเสียชีวิตกลางงานศพ ที่วัดบึงทองหลาง บาดเจ็บอีก 2 คน ลูก 2 ขวบสูญเสียทั้งพ่อและแม่
title_cn: 翁通杭寺葬礼枪战真相：家庭纠纷升级致多人伤亡
summary_cn: 翁通杭寺（Wat Bung Thonglang）葬礼现场枪战源于家庭纠纷。年长朋友因死者曾用枪伤害自己的妻子而心生怨恨，在获保释出狱后闯入葬礼现场开枪射击。死者当众身亡，事件中另有两人受伤，其中包括死者年仅2岁的幼子，该儿童因此同时失去父母。

summary_cn: 泰国著名医生Thanee从医学角度分析Hlun Solo的案例，表示乐意继续支持有志学医的年轻人。这反映了医学界对年轻医学从业者的鼓励与帮助。

title: Wat Pho: Beyond the Reclining Buddha
desc: Most visitors to Wat Pho come for one thing: the 46-metre-long, gold-plated Reclining Buddha. Its massive spectacle never fails to impress, but beyond the temple’s most photographed landmark lie centuries of history that many visitors never discover.
title_cn: 卧佛寺 Wat Pho：金色卧佛之外的故事
summary_cn: 卧佛寺（Wat Pho）最著名的是46米长的金色卧佛，壮观景象令人印象深刻，但这座寺庙的历史远超其最著名的地标。许多游客只来拍照打卡，却忽略了寺内数百年的丰富历史与文化底蕴。本文带领游客深入探索卧佛寺隐藏的故事与艺术价值，超越单纯的景点体验。
desc_original: Most visitors to Wat Pho come for one thing: the 46-metre-long, gold-plated Reclining Buddha. Its massive spectacle never fails to impress, but beyond the temple’s most photographed landmark lie centuries of history that many visitors never discover.

title: A tale of two tourist incidents
desc: Inviting the fury of the Thai public on a matter that is admittedly done and dusted, I cannot help but feel compelled to at least voice my misgivings over the recent “noisy Italian students” incident, especially how it played out compared with another similar occurrence.
title_cn: 两起游客事件的启示
summary_cn: 作者对近期「意大利学生吵闹」事件提出评论，对比分析了两起类似游客事件在泰国舆论中的不同反应。虽然事件已成过往，但这些事件引发的社会反应值得深思，反映了公众对游客行为规范和文化尊重的期待。相同性质的事件为何引起不同程度关注，也值得社会反思。
desc_original: Inviting the fury of the Thai public on a matter that is admittedly done and dusted, I cannot help but feel compelled to at least voice my misgivings over the recent “noisy Italian students” incident, especially how it played out compared with another similar occurrence.

title: Missing family of three found buried near Russians
desc: The arrest of two suspects who confessed to killing two Russian siblings in Chon Buri has led to another tragic discovery involving a Thai family of three who had been reported missing two months ago.
title_cn: 春武里发现失踪泰国三口之家遗体
summary_cn: 在追查两名俄罗斯兄妹在春武里（Chon Buri）被杀案过程中，警方逮捕的两名嫌疑人供述导致另一起悲剧发现——失踪两个月的泰国家庭三口已被埋藏。此案涉及多条人命，反映出严重的安全隐患，对当地居民和游客均构成威胁，引发公众对治安的担忧。
desc_original: The arrest of two suspects who confessed to killing two Russian siblings in Chon Buri has led to another tragic discovery involving a Thai family of three who had been reported missing two months ago.

title: Bhumjaithai raps iLaw over Senate poll probe
desc: The Bhumjaithai Party has accused iLaw of applying double standards in its scrutiny of the 2024 Senate election, saying it had overlooked similar conduct by the Progressive Movement.
title_cn: 泰党批评iLaw在参议院选举调查中双重标准

title: Court upholds Thailand’s ban on toxic farm chemicals
desc: The Central Administrative Court has upheld the Thai government's ban on the toxic agricultural chemicals paraquat and chlorpyrifos, ruling the measure is lawful because it protects public health and the environment.
title_cn: 泰国法院维持有毒农药禁令
summary_cn: 泰国中央行政法院裁定，政府禁止使用百草枯（Paraquat）和毒死蜱（Chlorpyrifos）等有毒农业化学品的措施合法有效。法院认为这一禁令对公众健康和环境保护至关重要，维持了环保和公共卫生政策的法律有效性，为公众安全筑起重要防线。
desc_original: The Central Administrative Court has upheld the Thai government's ban on the toxic agricultural chemicals paraquat and chlorpyrifos, ruling the measure is lawful because it protects public health and the environment.

title: 泰国政府升级打击“名义股东” 8月起严查资金流向与股权结构
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月1日，据泰媒报道，泰国总理府副发言人拉莉达表示，泰国商业部商业发展厅已发布命令，自今日起扩大企业审查范围，从原先重点审查公司设立环节，进一步延伸至公司注册后股东及董事结构的变更，堵塞外国资本通过调整股权结构规避法律监管的漏洞。 根据新措施，凡有外国人参与投资或拥有签字权的企业，须提交投资情况说明，并附上实际出资泰国投资者以及代为收取投资款的代表或法人机构近3个月的银行账户流水，用以核实投资资金来源及实际投资能力，提高企业登记环节的透明度，防止违法利用他人代持股份。 拉莉达强调，此次措施的核心是将审查范围扩大至法人企业运营的全周期，包括企业管理结构发生变化的阶段，堵截规避法律监管的渠道。政府旨在维护公平的商业竞争环境，保护合法经营的企业，同时强调相关措施并非针对或限制依法在泰国经营的外国投资者。 为提高审查效率，泰国政府已推动商业发展厅、土地厅及相关部门之间的数据互联，防止企业成为违法持有土地的工具，同时利用户籍登记数据库对股东身份进行详细核查。 此外，自8月1日起，商业发展厅将在股东名册副本中增加特别说明，明确告知公众，该文件仅为登记机关留存的资料，并非证明当前股东身份的证明文件。如需核实企业当前股东身份，应以公司依法保存的股东登记簿为准。 拉莉达进一步表示，目前泰国仍在运营的法人企业超过100万家，其中外资持股比例不超过49.99%的企业共有119116家。相关数据仅用于风险评估和初步筛查，并不意味着这些企业均属于“名义股东”安排或存在违法行为。政府将根据证据和实际情况，对个案进行依法处理。 拉莉达表示，泰国政府将继续推动建立透明、公平并具备国际竞争力的投资环境，为依法经营的泰国及外国投资者提供便利，同时打击利用名义代理人规避监管、损害国家经济体系的行为，长期增强企业界和公众的信心。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：thestandardth） The post 泰国政府升级打击“名义股东” 8月起严查资金流向与股权结构 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Democrats' balancing act
desc: The Democrat Party has long occupied a distinctive place in Thai politics. Traditionally seen as a conservative, pro-establishment party that nevertheless embraces parliamentary democracy and liberal economic policies, it has often served as a bridge between the traditional establishment and urban middle-class voters.
title_cn: 泰国民主党的政治平衡之道
summary_cn: 泰国民主党在政坛占据独特地位，传统上被视为保守的亲建制政党，却同时拥抱议会民主制度和自由经济政策，常充当传统权力建制与城市中产阶级选民之间的桥梁角色，这种平衡定位是其长期政治特色。

title: 泰国移民局警方逮捕中国籍诈骗犯
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，7月31日，泰国移民局警方在北榄府一处住宅内逮捕一名涉嫌诈骗、在泰逾期滞留126天的中国籍男子。警方表示，将全力配合中国警方完成后续司法程序。 泰国移民局表示，被捕的27岁中国籍男子XIE某，此前因涉嫌诈骗被中国广东省深圳市龙岗区公安机关通缉。同时，其涉嫌违法泰国《移民法》，构成非法逾期居留。 经调查，XIE某于2025年12月21日经曼谷廊曼国际机场入境泰国，获准停留至2026年3月20日，但签证到期后其未按规定离境，逾期滞留126天。 移民局警方掌握其藏匿于北榄府一处住宅后展开抓捕行动，确认身份后依法将其逮捕。随后，移民局调查部门将依法介入调查，并协调与中国有关部门对接后续司法程序。 泰国移民局表示，此次行动体现了持续追捕国际通缉犯、严厉打击违法滞留外国人的执法力度，重申“泰国不是跨国犯罪分子的藏身之地”。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan） The post 泰国移民局警方逮捕中国籍诈骗犯 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 阿努廷赶赴春武里督办命案，称绝不姑息凶手！
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，8月1日，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷表示，鉴于春武里府接连发生俄罗斯籍兄妹遇害案及一家三口命案，其决定取消原定下午在素攀武里府的行程，紧急赶赴春武里督办案件，强调将依法严惩凶手，绝不姑息。 8月1日上午，阿努廷在素攀武里府出席水稻降本增产项目活动时表示，原本是充满喜庆与吉祥的活动，却因两起恶性命案蒙上阴影。他表示，两名泰国人的犯罪行为严重损害了国家声誉，这不仅是杀害外国游客或杀害泰国人的恶性事件，也是在伤害整个泰国，破坏长期以来建立的国际信任。 阿努廷指出，涉案嫌疑人刚刑满释放，又重新涉足毒品问题，最终再次犯下严重罪行。基于案件影响重大，其决定取消下午在素攀武里府的既定行程，立即前往春武里府了解案件进展，向民众及外国游客展现政府维护社会治安的决心。 阿努廷强调，对于严重危害社会安全、损害国家形象的犯罪行为，政府将依法给予最严厉处罚，绝不会向犯罪嫌疑人提供任何便利或帮助，其将督促有关部门尽快完成调查，依法严惩涉案人员。 活动最后，阿努廷向素攀武里府民众致歉，表示因需赶赴春武里处理案件，无法继续参加后续活动。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：thestandard） The post 阿努廷赶赴春武里督办命案，称绝不姑息凶手！ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Anutin denies Cabinet reshuffle rumours
desc: Anutin denies Cabinet reshuffle rumours Legacy Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed speculation of an imminent Cabinet reshuffle, dismissing the rumours as baseless and warning that any changes would depend on ministers’ performance rather than a fixed schedule. Speaking at Government House on July 31, the interior minister rejected suggestions that the government was preparing to adjust its Cabinet after four months in office. He questioned where the reports had originated, suggesting they stemmed from television speculation rather than fact, and said all ministers remained focused on working according to the government’s direction. Asked whether a reshuffle might come after six months or a year, Anutin said the timing would depend on circumstances and should not be fixed in advance. He added that the prime minister holds the authority to make changes whenever necessary, particularly if a minister’s performance fails to benefit the country. “If someone does not create benefits for the country or causes damage, there is no need to wait for a scheduled reshuffle,” Anutin said. title: 泰国警方抓获俄籍兄妹命案嫌犯，两人对所犯罪行供认不讳
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道 7月31日，泰国警方在沙缴府成功抓获涉嫌杀害俄罗斯籍兄妹的两名嫌疑人，两人承认将俄罗斯籍兄妹残忍杀害，并埋尸于春武里府的一处山区。目前，警方正进一步核实供述内容，并展开后续调查。 据悉，22岁的俄罗斯籍女子Ianna Naksimova及17岁的弟弟Roman Naksimov此前在春武里府Huai Yai辖区离奇失踪。警方调查后锁定Pong和Thong的两名嫌疑人，但两人已逃离当地。 警方随后发现，两名嫌疑人身穿仿制警察制服，骑摩托车冲闯尖竹汶府检查站，向沙缴府方向逃逸。第二警区随即部署大规模追捕行动，加强边境地区布控，对长途客运车辆实施重点检查。 7月31日下午，警方在沙缴府成功将两人抓获。据警方介绍，嫌疑人Thong供称，Pong持枪杀害两名俄罗斯籍兄妹，随后将尸体埋在春武里府Chi Chan山附近，地点靠近警方此前发现摩托车挡泥板的位置。 另一名嫌疑人Pong则供称，自己开枪杀害弟弟，姐姐则因遭殴打身亡，否认对其实施性侵，称作案目的仅为抢夺受害人的摩托车。案发后，两人将尸体掩埋后潜逃。 警方表示，目前尚未完全采信嫌疑人的供述，案件仍在进一步审讯中，后续将带领嫌疑人指认埋尸地点，依法展开进一步调查。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：dailynews） The post 泰国警方抓获俄籍兄妹命案嫌犯，两人对所犯罪行供认不讳 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Thailand calls for peaceful talks on Cambodia border row
desc: Thailand calls for peaceful talks on Cambodia border row Legacy Thailand’s Joint Information Center has firmly rejected claims made by the spokesperson for Cambodia’s Ministry of National Defence regarding the Thailand-Cambodia Joint Boundary Commission, insisting that ongoing border disputes must be resolved through agreed bilateral channels rather than public statements. The centre said Thailand remains committed to peaceful resolution and continues to support the work of the Joint Boundary Commission, the General Border Committee, and other established mechanisms tasked with addressing border issues, including joint survey and demarcation efforts. Among the claims rejected was an allegation that Thai forces had occupied Cambodian territory. The Joint Information Center said this does not reflect the facts on the ground, stressing that Thailand’s actions remain consistent with the Joint Statement signed by both countries on December 27 last year, an agreement aimed at reducing tensions and maintaining stability along the shared border. title_cn: SET100指数内5只重挫股票浮现抄底机会
summary_cn: 虽然 SET 指数 2026 年迄今上涨超 26.87%，但 SET100 成分股中仍有泰国航空（THAI）、曼谷资产管理（BAM）、BTS 集团（BTS）、大正水产（GFPT）和暹罗优先基金（AAV）等 5 只个股逆势下跌，表现最差。这些股票受自身压力影响，可能成为投资者的入场机会。

title: Missing Russian siblings found murdered, buried in Pattaya, suspects arrested
desc: Missing Russian siblings found murdered, buried in Pattaya, suspects arrested Legacy Two Thai men arrested today, July 31, in Sa Kaeo over the disappearance of two Russian siblings in Pattaya reportedly confessed to killing them and burying their bodies. The case attracted public attention after the Russian mother, Sarina Nazimova, reported her children, 22 year old Diana Nazimova and 17 year old Roman Nazimova, missing at Huay Yai Police Station on July 28. Police said CCTV footage showed the siblings for the last time near a bridge on the Map Ta Phut-Na Jomtien Motorway. The pair were seen speaking with an unidentified man and being followed by another motorcyclist shortly before they disappeared. On July 29, residents alerted police after seeing four men carrying digging equipment near an abandoned crematorium close to the bridge at about 10pm on July 28. Thana “Pong” Kirdthong | Photo via Amarin TV Officers searched the area and found the motorcycle rented by the Russian siblings dismantled and buried in two separate pits. title: Thai embassy denies receiving early report of YouTuber’s death
desc: Thai embassy denies receiving early report of YouTuber’s death Legacy The Royal Thai Embassy in Ankara called on Georgian authorities to clarify why notification of the Hlun Solo death was delayed , saying it did not receive any official report on July 14 despite claims circulating on social media. The embassy and the family of Thai travel YouTuber, Hlun Solo, whose real name was Bawonthat Pengsuk, confirmed his death on July 30 after he had been reported missing during a solo trip to Georgia . According to Thai media reports, Hlun checked into a hotel in Tbilisi on July 13 and was later found dead in his room after hotel staff checked on him when he failed to leave the accommodation. Thai media reported that Georgian police found no visible signs of injury on the body. His body was transferred to the Levan Samkharauli National Forensics Bureau for an autopsy, and the cause of death remains under investigation. Photo via Facebook/ ฮลุน โซโล่ Thai travel blogger Akira “Wanchai” Wongseng, who helped search for Hlun , said he had spoken with Georgian police, who told him the body had been discovered on July 14. The reported timeline prompted questions from the public

title: Is Thailand safe to visit? What every tourist (and expats) should know
desc: Is Thailand safe to visit? What every tourist (and expats) should know Legacy Thailand receives more than 35 million international visitors a year. The vast majority leave without any safety incident worth reporting. So when people ask whether Thailand is safe, the accurate answer is yes, with some qualifications that are worth understanding before you arrive rather than after. The three areas that actually catch tourists and expats out are road safety, scams, and the legal framework. Natural hazards matter in specific seasons and locations. Violent crime against foreign visitors is rare, but it is not zero. Here is what the evidence shows for each. title: Andros Townsend misses Thailand’s cheap coconuts after US stay
desc: Andros Townsend misses Thailand’s cheap coconuts after US stay Legacy Former England footballer Andros Townsend has praised Thailand’s cheap fresh coconuts after revealing they cost nearly eight times less than in the United States. Townsend, who is set to join PT Prachuap FC, posted a video on his TikTok account yesterday, July 30, showing himself buying an aromatic coconut from a roadside stall in Thailand. Townsend said he had missed his daily coconuts after spending a month in the United States during the FIFA World Cup 2026 , adding that he was back to natural electrolytes. He noted that an aromatic coconut in Thailand costs just 20 baht, or about 45 pence. By comparison, he said a coconut in the United States costs US$4.99 (around 160 baht), nearly eight times the price. @androstownsend Nobody talks about how hard it is to go from this… 😂🥥 20 baht, which equals just 45p… then spending a month in the US where the same coconut was $4.99. 😭 Safe to say I’ve missed my daily coconuts. title: Thai man swims across Thai-Cambodian border after scam operation escape
desc: Thai man swims across Thai-Cambodian border after scam operation escape Legacy A Thai man swam across a border canal into Thailand today, July 31, after escaping a scam operation in Poipet , Cambodia, where he said he had been forced to work for more than three years after being lured by a fake job advertisement on TikTok. Soldiers from the Burapha Task Force, including the Aranyaprathet Task Force intelligence unit and Ranger Company 1203, detained the 19 year old near a natural border crossing in Tha Kham subdistrict, Aranyaprathet district, Sa Kaeo province. The officers had been monitoring the area following reports of an illegal border crossing . They spotted the Thai man emerging from the border area on foot and detained him. No smuggler was found with him. Photo via Amarin TV The man told investigators that three years ago he applied for a job through TikTok after seeing an advertisement for a chat administrator position offering a monthly salary of 20,000 baht. title: Why Phuket property management has become essential for overseas owners
desc: Why Phuket property management has become essential for overseas owners Legacy Phuket is in the middle of a property boom, and the buyers are no longer mostly local. According to C9 Hotelworks’ 2025 Phuket market update , the island handled around 8.8 million airport arrivals last year. Fresh demand is coming from India, South Korea, and the Middle East as Chinese travel slowly returns. Many of the people buying homes here come from Russia and CIS countries, Europe, the Gulf, and India, and a large share will never live on the island full time. That one fact has quietly reshaped the market. It has turned property management into one of the most important businesses in Phuket. When an owner lives in Dubai or London, the property in Rawai does not run itself. Someone has to handle the bookings, the pricing, the cleaning, the guest at midnight, the broken pump, and a growing list of legal rules. This is the gap a professional manager fills. It is also why a few established operators have grown alongside the boom. title: Japanese prosecutors drop charges against Thai woman found with crystal meth
desc: Japanese prosecutors drop charges against Thai woman found with crystal meth Legacy Japanese prosecutors dropped legal proceedings against a Thai woman who was arrested at Fukuoka Airport after crystal meth was discovered hidden inside coffee and tea packages she was carrying. The arrest of the 28 year old Juthathip in Japan attracted public attention after her family appealed to Thai authorities and the media, maintaining that she had unknowingly transported the drugs after being recruited by a suspected trafficking network. According to Juthathip’s boyfriend, the couple operated a courier service transporting goods between Thailand and Japan . He said Juthathip was contacted through the LINE application by a user identified as “Ing Ing”, who offered her 3,500 baht to transport 12 kilogrammes of goods to Fukuoka. The boyfriend said the couple travelled to Japan on July 12 carrying nine parcels, accompanied by another person. He said immigration officers questioned three of them on arrival, but Juthathip was the only person detained. Juthathip’s mother | Photo via MGR Online Her boyfriend and parents were later informed that crystal meth was found concealed

title: Rodtang apologises to ONE, vows world title return
desc: Rodtang apologises to ONE, vows world title return Legacy Rodtang Jitmuangnon has apologised to ONE Championship and the promotion’s matchmaking team following recent misunderstandings, admitting he was influenced by people seeking to benefit from his success. The former ONE Flyweight Muay Thai world champion shared the statement on his Facebook page yesterday, July 30, after signing a new contract with ONE Championship, ending months of uncertainty over his future with the organisation. The dispute was eventually resolved with the help of senior figures from Jitmuangnon Gym. “I’d like to use this opportunity to clarify everything one final time so I can move forward and focus on my future,” Rodtang wrote. He said that after achieving fame and financial success, many new people entered his life, but not all of them had good intentions. “Many of them were only interested in benefiting from me financially. I don’t want to go into detail, but I made the mistake of following the advice of that group. The former ONE Flyweight Muay Thai world champion shared the statement on his Facebook page yesterday, July 30, after signing a new contract with ONE Championship, ending months of uncertainty over his future with the organisation. The dispute was eventually resolved with the help of senior figures from Jitmuangnon Gym. “I’d like to use this opportunity to clarify everything one final time so I can move forward and focus on my future,” Rodtang wrote. He said that after achieving fame and financial success, many new people entered his life, but not all of them had good intentions. “Many of them were only interested in benefiting from me financially. I don’t want to go into detail, but I made the mistake of following the advice of that group. title: 投资额飙升！泰国迈向全球“光”生产基地
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 7月30日，AI热潮不仅为芯片制造商或数据中心带来了机遇，还推动了光子产业的发展，这种利用“光”进行高速数据传输的通信技术，是AI、云计算和新一代通信网络的核心所在。泰国投资促进委员会（BOI）透露，2021年至2026年6月期间，光子产业的投资项目共79个，总投资额超过827亿泰铢，表明泰国正在逐步成为全球AI产业链的重要生产基地。 互联网用户在使用AI、在线观看视频或进行视频会议时，海量数据都会通过光纤和光子技术进行传输，这种传输速度更快、能耗更低，且能承载巨量数据的技术，在AI数据中心和云计算系统中不可或缺。泰国的光子产业并非仅生产零配件，而是拥有涵盖整个产业链的投资，从光纤、光学元件到用于连接AI数据中心服务器的光收发器，应有尽有。 泰国的多家生产商已经成为英伟达（Nvidia）、思科（Cisco）和亚马逊云科技（AWS）等全球科技巨头的供应商，同时也为泰国本土创造了超过20,000个就业岗位。另外，超过60%的项目位于东部经济走廊（EEC）以外的地区，有助于将投资和就业分流至多个府。 超过827亿泰铢的投资是推动泰国向高新技术升级的重要机遇，但面临着重大挑战，比如泰国是将仅仅作为“生产基地”，还是能够进一步延伸至自主研发与创新；还有一个关键课题是，如何培养足够的高技能人才以满足产业需求。 虽然光子产业的投资数据表明，泰国在全球AI产业链中扮演着越来越重要的角色，但AI时代的竞争不只取决于资金投入，更在于“人才”与“知识储备”的较量，只有具备培养人才、发展开发技术，以及在本土创造附加价值的能力，才能在未来实现从“生产基地”向“创新基地”的转变。 （编译：KA；来源：pptvhd36） The post 投资额飙升！泰国迈向全球“光”生产基地 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 曼谷核心区要禁非电动“嘟嘟车”？
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 7月31日，泰国陆路运输厅近日通过官方网站就禁止内燃机“嘟嘟车”驶入曼谷核心区公开征求意见，旨在治理噪音和空气污染问题。陆运厅表示，曼谷核心区汇集了泰国诸多重要场所，如玉佛寺、各大皇家寺庙和国家级古迹等，是国内外游客青睐的旅游打卡地，有必要将其划定为内燃机三轮出租车“嘟嘟车”的管控区。 为此，陆运厅制定了《禁止特定类型三轮出租车在曼谷核心区行驶的部级法规（草案）》，并于2026年7月28日至8月27日期间开放公众意见征集，以便将各方反馈纳入后续考量。该法规草案的核心原则为：禁止内燃机三轮出租车在曼谷核心区内行驶，但电动三轮出租车（电动“嘟嘟车”）或政府公告允许的时段除外。 玉佛寺周边区域的“嘟嘟车”司机普遍对该法规草案持反对意见。他们说，电动“嘟嘟车”的租金很贵，和每日收入相比并不划算，而且玉佛寺紧邻大皇宫，所有司机都十分配合，没有私自改装排气管制造噪音，车辆大多保持着出厂原装的引擎，如果真要解决问题，更应该去治理公交车排放黑烟造成的空气污染。 一些游客群体认为，由“嘟嘟车”带来的噪音和空气污染问题是可以通过政府部门与司机双方沟通、共同协商解决的。如果未来真的立法禁止内燃机“嘟嘟车”在各大景点为游客提供服务，可能会削弱泰国的特色形象，因为在外国游客眼中，“嘟嘟车”是泰国的标志之一，是人生中值得体验的特色项目。 （编译：KA；来源：ch7） The post 曼谷核心区要禁非电动“嘟嘟车”？ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 曼谷核心区拟禁内燃机三轮出租车，保护名胜古迹环境
summary_cn: 泰国陆路运输厅提出草案，拟禁止内燃机三轮出租车（「嘟嘟车」）在曼谷核心区行驶，以治理噪音和空气污染。核心区包含玉佛寺、皇家寺庙等重要场所。但司机反对，认为电动车成本高；游客担忧禁令会削弱泰国特色。陆运厅于7月28日至8月27日开放意见征集。各方建议通过协商和管理公交排放等措施解决问题。

title: 清迈“最热”，中国游客暑期出境游首选泰国
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 7月30日，中国在线旅游平台“去哪儿（Qunar）”透露，泰国是2026年暑期中国大陆游客出境游的第一大目的地，其中清迈因体验式旅游热潮，如学做泰国菜、练泰拳和瑜伽等备受青睐，其酒店预订量增幅高达3.3倍。据悉，这几年游客的出行习惯正在发生变化，体验式旅游和在旅途中学习新技能越来越受到关注。 其他受中国大陆游客喜爱的热门出境游目的地还包括：韩国、马来西亚、新加坡、中国香港、印度尼西亚和美国。与此同时，中国大陆的入境旅游市场也在持续扩大，上海、北京、广州和成都等城市最受外国游客欢迎。从客源地来看，今年暑期入境中国大陆游客数量最多的国家和地区包括：泰国、加拿大、美国、英国和俄罗斯；另外，来自希腊、斯里兰卡、蒙古、瑞典、芬兰和墨西哥的游客数量也有明显增长。 （编译：KA；来源：thebangkokinsight） The post 清迈“最热”，中国游客暑期出境游首选泰国 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
